To address this issue, our study implements a tool called Colaine to automatically check the compliance of privacy label disclosure guidelines, taking into account the configurable data practices in TPLs. Colaine analyzed 107 TPLs associated with 1,605 different configurations, shedding light on the prevalence and seriousness of privacy label disclosure guideline non-compliance issues.
paper.author: Yue Xiao (Indiana University Bloomington), Chaoqi Zhang (Indiana University Bloomington), Yue Qin (Indiana University Bloomington), Fares Fahad S Alharbi (Indiana University Bloomington), Luyi Xing (Indiana University Bloomington), Xiaojing Liao (Indiana University Bloomington)
paper.summary_zh: iOS 应用必须通过隐私标签披露数据实践，第三方库（TPL）的隐私标签披露指南可帮助开发者准确完成标签，但其准确性和合规性尚不清楚。本文实现工具 Colaine，自动检查隐私标签披露指南的合规性，并考虑 TPL 中可配置的数据实践。作者分析了 107 个 TPL 及其 1,605 种不同配置，揭示了隐私标签披露指南不合规问题的普遍性和严重性。

paper.title: Data Independent Order Policy Enforcement: Limitations and Solutions
paper.description: Order manipulation attacks such as frontrunning and sandwiching have become an increasing concern in blockchain applications such as DeFi. To protect from such attacks, several recent works have designed order policy enforcement (OPE) protocols to order transactions fairly in a data-independent fashion. However, while the manipulation attacks are motivated by monetary profits, the defenses assume honesty among a significantly large set of participants. In existing protocols, if all participants are rational, they may be incentivized to collude and circumvent the order policy without incurring any penalty.
paper.author: Sarisht Wadhwa (Duke University), Luca Zanolini (Ethereum Foundation), Aditya Asgaonkar (Ethereum Foundation), Francesco D'Amato (Ethereum Foundation), Fan Zhang (Yale University), Kartik Nayak (Duke University), Chengrui Fang (Zhejiang University)
paper.summary_zh: 区块链 DeFi 应用中，抢跑和三明治等顺序操纵攻击日益严重，已有工作设计数据无关的顺序策略执行（OPE）协议来公平排序交易。然而，这些防御通常假设大量参与者诚实；若参与者均为理性，他们可能被激励合谋绕过顺序策略而不受惩罚。本文分析现有 OPE 协议的这一局限并提出解决方案。摘要未提供具体方案细节和实验结果。

paper.title: Fast and Accurate Homomorphic Softmax Evaluation
paper.description: Homomorphic encryption is one of the main solutions for building secure and privacy-preserving solutions for Machine Learning as a Service, a major challenge in a society where AI becomes more and more pervasive. This motivates the development of homomorphic algorithms for the main building blocks of AI, typically for the components of the various types of neural networks architectures.
paper.author: Wonhee Cho (Departement of Mathematics, Seoul National University), Guillaume Hanrot (Cryptolab, Inc.), Taeseong Kim (Departement of Mathematics, Seoul National University), Minje Park (Cryptolab, Inc.), Damien Stehlé (Cryptolab, Inc.)
paper.summary_zh: 同态加密是构建隐私保护机器学习即服务的重要方案，而 AI 日益普及使得为神经网络组件设计高效同态算法成为关键挑战。本文聚焦 Softmax 的同态评估，提出快速且准确的同态 Softmax 算法。摘要未给出具体性能提升数据，但目标是在保持精度的同时降低同态计算开销。

paper.title: Securing Lightning Channels against Rational Miners
paper.description: Payment channel networks (e.g., the Lightning Network in Bitcoin) constitute one of the most popular scalability solutions for blockchains. Their safety relies on parties being online to detect fraud attempts on-chain and being able to timely react by publishing certain transactions on-chain. However, a cheating party may bribe miners in order to censor those transactions, resulting in loss of funds for the cheated party: these attacks are known in the literature as timelock bribing attacks. In this work, we present the first channel construction that does not require parties to be online and, at the same time, is resistant to timelock bribing attacks.
paper.author: Lukas Aumayr (TU Wien), Zeta Avarikioti (TU Wien), Matteo Maffei (TU Wien, Christian Doppler Laboratory Blockchain Technologies for the Internet of Things, Vienna), Subhra Mazumdar (TU Wien, Christian Doppler Laboratory Blockchain Technologies for the Internet of Things, Vienna)
paper.summary_zh: 支付通道网络（如比特币闪电网络）是区块链重要的扩容方案，其安全性依赖参与方在线检测欺诈并及时上链交易。然而，作弊方可能贿赂矿工审查相关交易，导致被欺诈方资金损失，这类攻击称为 timelock bribing 攻击。本文提出首个不需要参与方在线且能抵抗 timelock bribing 攻击的通道构造。摘要未给出具体性能或实验结果。

paper.title: Provable Security for PKI Schemes
paper.description: PKI schemes provide a critical foundation for applied cryptographic protocols. However, there are no rigorous security specifications for realistic PKI schemes, and therefore, no PKI schemes were proven secure. Cryptographic systems that use PKI are analyzed by adopting overly simplified models of PKI, often simply assuming securely-distributed public keys. This is problematic given the extensive reliance on PKI, the multiple failures of PKI systems, and the complexity of both proposed and deployed systems, which involve complex requirements and models.
paper.author: Sara Wrótniak (Dept. of Computer Science and Engineering, University of Connecticut, Storrs, CT), Hemi Leibowitz (School of Computer Science, The College of Management Academic Studies Rishon Lezion, Israel), Ewa Syta (Dept. of Computer Science, Trinity College, Hartford, CT), Amir Herzberg (Dept. of Computer Science and Engineering, University of Connecticut, Storrs, CT)
paper.summary_zh: PKI 方案是应用密码协议的关键基础，但目前缺乏严格的安全规范，尚无 PKI 方案被证明安全。使用 PKI 的密码系统通常采用过度简化的 PKI 模型，假设公钥已被安全分发，这与 PKI 的广泛依赖、多次失败以及已部署系统的复杂性不符。本文旨在为现实 PKI 方案建立可证明安全框架或规范。摘要未详述具体模型和结果。

paper.title: Not One Less: Exploring Interplay between User Profiles and Items in Untargeted Attacks against Federated Recommendation
paper.description: Federated recommendation (FR) is a decentralised approach to training personalised recommender systems, protecting users' privacy by avoiding data collection. Despite its privacy advantages, FR remains vulnerable to poisoning attacks. We focus on untargeted poisoning attacks against FR which degrade the overall performance of recommender services, leading to a detrimental impact on user experience and service quality. In this paper, we propose a general framework to formalise untargeted attacks and identify the vital role played by the interplay between items and user profiles in determining FR's performance. We present an untargeted attack FRecAttack2 which exploits this interplay. Specifically, we develop various methods for sampling user profiles, which approximate user distributions with and without collusion among malicious users. Then we leverage a new measurement to identify items that can disrupt the original interplay with user profiles, based on the change velocity of items' recommendation scores during optimisation. Extensive experiments demonstrate the superiority of our attack, outperforming existing methods by up to 27.56%, and its stealthiness in evading mainstream defences. To counteract untargeted attacks, we present a defence GuardCQ to detect malicious users by quantifying their contribution to boost the right interplay between items and user profiles. Empirical results show that GuardCQ effectively mitigates the attack's impact on FR and enhances the robustness of FR against poisoning attacks.
paper.author: yurong Hao (Beijing Jiaotong University), Xihui Chen (University of Luxembourg), Xiaoting Lyu (Beijing Jiaotong University), Jiqiang Liu (Beijing Jiaotong University), Yongsheng Zhu (Beijing Jiaotong University), Zhiguo Wan (Zhejiang Lab, Hangzhou, China), Sjouke Mauw (University of Luxembourg), Wei Wang (Beijing Jiaotong University)
paper.summary_zh: 联邦推荐（FR）通过避免数据收集来保护用户隐私，但仍易受投毒攻击，尤其是降低整体推荐性能的无目标攻击。本文提出一个通用框架来形式化无目标攻击，并揭示物品与用户画像之间的交互对 FR 性能的关键作用。作者设计攻击 FRecAttack2，通过采样用户画像并基于推荐分数变化速度选择破坏物品，实验表明其效果优于现有方法最多 27.56%，并能规避主流防御。为缓解该攻击，作者提出防御 GuardCQ，通过量化用户对正确交互的贡献来检测恶意用户，实验显示其能有效减轻攻击影响并增强 FR 鲁棒性。

paper.title: PLeak: Prompt Leaking Attacks against Large Language Model Applications
paper.description: Large Language Models (LLMs) enable a new ecosystem with many downstream applications, called LLM applications, with different natural language processing tasks. The functionality and performance of an LLM application highly depend on its system prompt, which instructs the backend LLM on what task to perform. Therefore, an LLM application developer often keeps a system prompt confidential to protect its intellectual property. As a result, a natural attack, called prompt leaking, is to steal the system prompt from an LLM application, which compromises the developer's intellectual property. Existing prompt leaking attacks primarily rely on manually crafted queries, and thus achieve limited effectiveness.
paper.author: Bo Hui (Johns Hopkins University), Haolin Yuan (Johns Hopkins University), Neil Gong (Duke University), Philippe Burlina (JHU/APL), Yinzhi Cao (Johns Hopkins University)
paper.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）应用的功能和性能高度依赖系统提示，开发者通常将其保密以保护知识产权，因此提示泄露攻击成为现实威胁。现有提示泄露攻击主要依赖手工构造查询，攻击效果有限。本文提出 PLeak 提示泄露攻击，旨在提升从 LLM 应用中窃取系统提示的有效性。摘要未提供具体攻击方法和实验结果的细节。

paper.title: When Compiler Optimizations Meet Symbolic Execution: An Empirical Study
paper.description: Compiler optimizations intend to transform a program into a semantic-equivalent one with improved performance, but it is unclear how these optimizations may impact the performance of dynamic symbolic execution (DSE) on binary code. To systematically understand the impact of compiler optimizations on two popular DSE techniques (i.e., symbolic exploration and symbolic tracing), this paper presents an empirical study that quantifies 209 GCC compilation flags and 73 Clang compilation flags to reveal both positive and negative optimizations to DSE. Our data set contains 992 unique test cases, which are produced from 3,449 source files in the GCC test suite. After analyzing 2,978,976 binary programs that we compiled with two compilers and various compilation flags, we found that although some optimizations make DSE faster, most optimizations will actually slow down DSE. Our analysis further reveals root causes behind these impacts. The most positive impacts that optimizations have on DSE come from the reduction of the number of instructions and program paths, whereas negative impacts are caused by a series of unexpected behaviors, including increased numbers of instructions or program paths, library function inlining preventing DSE engines from using function summaries, and arithmetic optimizations leading to more sophisticated constraints. Being the first in-depth analysis on why compiler flags influence the performance of DSE, this project sheds light on program transformations that can be applied before performing DSE tasks for better performance.
paper.author: Yue Zhang (Drexel University), Melih Sirlanci (Ohio State University), Ruoyu Wang (Arizona State University), Zhiqiang Lin (Ohio State University)
paper.summary_zh: 编译器优化旨在将程序转换为语义等价且性能更好的形式，但其对二进制代码动态符号执行（DSE）性能的影响尚不明确。本文进行实证研究，量化 209 个 GCC 编译标志和 73 个 Clang 编译标志对符号探索与符号追踪两类 DSE 技术的影响。作者使用来自 GCC 测试套件的 3,449 个源文件生成 992 个唯一测试用例，并编译分析了 2,978,976 个二进制程序。发现部分优化可加速 DSE，但大多数优化反而减慢 DSE；正面影响主要来自指令和路径数量减少，负面影响包括指令/路径增加、库函数内联阻止摘要使用、算术优化导致更复杂约束。该工作首次深入分析编译器标志影响 DSE 性能的原因，为 DSE 前的程序变换提供指导。

paper.title: Understanding Cross-Platform Referral Traffic for Illicit Drug Promotion
paper.author: Mingming Zha (Indiana University Bloomington), Zilong Lin (Indiana University Bloomington), Siyuan Tang (Indiana University Bloomington), Xiaojing Liao (Indiana University Bloomington), Yuhong Nan (Sun Yat-sen University), XiaoFeng Wang (Indiana University Bloomington)
paper.summary_zh: 该论文关注非法药物推广中的跨平台推荐流量问题，研究用户如何在不同在线平台之间被引导至非法药物相关内容或销售渠道。通过分析跨平台 referral traffic，作者旨在刻画非法药物推广的流量路径、平台间协作模式及其背后的推广生态。该工作有助于理解网络非法药物市场的跨平台引流机制，并为检测和干预此类活动提供依据。

paper.title: Untangling the Knot: Breaking Access Control in Home Wireless Mesh Networks
paper.description: Home wireless mesh networks (WMNs) are increasingly gaining popularity for their superior extensibility and signal coverage compared to traditional single-AP wireless networks. In particular, there is a single gateway node and multiple extender nodes that cooperate to provide wireless coverage. We observe that there is no comprehensive research conducted on the security aspects of the control plane of such networks. For example, this decentralized architecture enables each extender node to independently authenticate wireless clients by synchronizing access control policies from the gateway node. However, this synchronization unexpectedly opens an attack surface which has not been scrutinized.
paper.author: Xin'an Zhou (University of California, Riverside), Qing Deng (University of California, Riverside), Juefei Pu (University of California, Riverside), Keyu Man (University of California, Riverside), Zhiyun Qian (University of California, Riverside), Srikanth V. Krishnamurthy (University of California, Riverside)
paper.summary_zh: 家庭无线网状网络（WMN）由单个网关和多个扩展节点协作提供覆盖，扩展节点会从网关同步访问控制策略并独立认证无线客户端。论文指出这种去中心化同步机制形成了此前未被充分审视的攻击面，并系统分析了其控制面安全。作者发现可利用该机制破坏访问控制，揭示家庭WMN中扩展节点同步策略带来的安全风险。该研究有助于理解并修复家庭无线网状网络的访问控制缺陷。

paper.title: Inbox Invasion: Exploiting MIME Ambiguities to Evade Email Attachment Detectors
paper.description: Email attachments have become a favored delivery vector for malware campaigns. In response, email attachment detectors are widely deployed to safeguard email security. However, an emerging threat arises when adversaries exploit parsing discrepancies between email detectors and clients to evade detection. Currently, uncovering these vulnerabilities still depends on manual, ad hoc methods. In this paper, we perform the first systematic evaluation of email attachment detection against parsing ambiguity vulnerabilities. We propose a novel testing methodology, MIMEminer, to systematically discover evasion vulnerabilities in email systems. We evaluated our methodology against 16 content detectors of popular email services like Gmail and iCloud, and 7 popular email clients like Outlook and Thunderbird. In total, we discovered 19 new evasion methods affecting all tested email services and clients. We further analyzed these vulnerabilities and identified three primary categories of malware evasions. We have responsibly reported those identified vulnerabilities to the affected providers to help with the remediation of such vulnerabilities and received acknowledgments from Google Gmail, Apple iCloud, Coremail, Tencent, Amavis and Perl MIME-tools.
paper.author: Jiahe Zhang (Tsinghua University), Jianjun Chen (Tsinghua University & Zhongguancun Laboratory), Qi Wang (Tsinghua University), Hangyu Zhang (Tsinghua University), Chuhan Wang (Tsinghua University), Jianwei Zhuge (Tsinghua University & Zhongguancun Laboratory), Haixin Duan (Tsinghua University & Zhongguancun Laboratory)
paper.summary_zh: 电子邮件附件是恶意软件常用的投递载体，邮件附件检测器被广泛部署以保障安全，但攻击者可利用邮件检测器与客户端之间的解析差异绕过检测。论文首次系统评估了邮件附件检测在面对解析歧义漏洞时的表现，并提出新型测试方法MIMEminer来自动发现邮件系统中的规避漏洞。作者评估了Gmail、iCloud等流行邮件服务的16个内容检测器以及Outlook、Thunderbird等7个客户端，共发现19种影响所有测试服务与客户端的新规避方法，并归纳为三类主要恶意软件规避。相关漏洞已负责任地报告给受影响厂商并获确认。

paper.title: New Secret Keys for Enhanced Performance in (T)FHE
paper.description: Fully Homomorphic Encryption has known impressive improvements in the last 15 years, going from a technology long thought to be impossible to an existing family of encryption schemes able to solve a plethora of practical use cases related to the privacy of sensitive information. Recent results mainly focus on improving techniques within the traditionally defined framework of GLWE-based schemes, but the recent CPU implementation improvements are mainly incremental. To keep improving this technology, one solution is to modify the aforementioned framework, by using slightly different hardness assumptions.
paper.author: Loris Bergerat (Zama, Normandie Univ, UNICAEN, ENSICAEN, CNRS, GREYC, 14000 Caen, France), Ilaria Chillotti (Unaffiliated), Damien Ligier (Unaffiliated), Jean-Baptiste Orfila (Zama), Adeline Roux-Langlois (Normandie Univ, UNICAEN, ENSICAEN, CNRS, GREYC, 14000 Caen, France), Samuel Tap (Zama)
paper.summary_zh: 全同态加密在过去15年取得显著进展，但近期基于GLWE框架的CPU实现改进主要呈增量式，性能提升面临瓶颈。论文提出通过修改传统框架并采用略有不同的困难性假设，引入新的秘密密钥类型，以增强(T)FHE方案的性能。该方法为同态加密在敏感信息隐私计算中的实用化提供了新的优化方向。

paper.title: Interactive Multi-Credential Authentication
paper.author: Deepak Maram (Mysten Labs, Cornell Tech), Mahimna Kelkar (Cornell Tech), Ittay Eyal (Technion)
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究交互式多凭证认证问题，目标是克服单一凭证认证在凭证泄露、冒用和可用性方面的局限。其核心思路可能是在认证过程中引入多个凭证的交互式组合验证，使用户只有在满足多凭证条件时才能完成认证，从而提升安全性。由于提供的摘要为空，具体协议构造、安全模型和实验效果无法从现有片段中确认。

paper.title: Efficient Secret Sharing for Large-Scale Applications
paper.description: Threshold secret sharing enables distributing a message to n parties such that no subset of fewer than t parties can learn the message, whereas any subset of at least t parties can recover the message. Despite being a fundamental primitive, secret sharing still suffers from one significant drawback, where its message reconstruction algorithm is computationally expensive for large privacy thresholds t. In this paper, we aim to address this significant drawback.
paper.author: Sarvar Patel (Google), Giuseppe Persiano (Universita' di Salerno and Google), Joon Young Seo (Google), Kevin Yeo (Google and Columbia University)
paper.summary_zh: 阈值秘密分享是一种基础密码原语，可将消息分发给n个参与方，但现有方案在隐私阈值t较大时消息重构算法计算开销过高，限制其大规模应用。论文针对这一瓶颈提出高效秘密分享方案，重点优化大阈值场景下的重构效率。该工作面向大规模应用场景，旨在降低秘密分享的计算成本并提升实用性。

paper.title: HomeRun: High-efficiency Oblivious Message Retrieval, Unrestricted
paper.author: Yanxue Jia (Purdue University), Varun Madathil (North Carolina State University), Aniket Kate (Purdue University / Supra Research)
paper.summary_zh: 该论文研究隐私保护场景中的不经意消息检索（Oblivious Message Retrieval），目标是在不泄露用户查询内容的前提下高效检索消息。针对现有方案在效率或适用范围上的限制，作者提出HomeRun协议，强调高效率和不受限制的检索能力。该工作面向需要隐藏消息访问模式的隐私系统，为可扩展的oblivious retrieval提供了新的密码学构造。

paper.title: ArcEDB: An Arbitrary-Precision Encrypted Database via (Amortized) Modular Homomorphic Encryption
paper.description: Fully homomorphic encryption (FHE) based database outsourcing is drawing growing research interests. At its current state, there exist two primary obstacles against FHE-based encrypted databases (EDBs): i) low data precision, and ii) high computational latency. To tackle the precision-performance dilemma, we introduce ArcEDB, a novel FHE-based SQL evaluation infrastructure that simultaneously achieves high data precision and fast query evaluation. Based on a set of new plaintext encoding schemes, we are able to execute arbitrary-precision ciphertext-to-ciphertext homomorphic comparison orders of magnitude faster than existing methods. Meanwhile, we propose efficient conversion algorithms between the encoding schemes to support highly composite SQL statements, including advanced filter-aggregation and multi-column synchronized sorting. We perform comprehensive experiments to study the performance characteristics of ArcEDB. In particular, we show that ArcEDB can be up to 57× faster in homomorphic filtering and up to 20× faster over end-to-end SQL queries when compared to the state-of-the-art FHE-based EDB solutions. Using ArcEDB, a SQL query over a 10K-row time-series EDB with 64-bit timestamps only runs for under one minute.
paper.author: Zhou Zhang (Beihang University), Song Bian (Beihang University), Zian Zhao (Beihang University), Ran Mao (Beihang University), Haoyi Zhou (Beihang University), Jiafeng Hua (Huawei Technology), Yier Jin (University of Science and Technology of China), Zhenyu Guan (Beihang University)
paper.summary_zh: 基于全同态加密（FHE）的数据库外包受到低数据精度和高计算延迟两大障碍制约。论文提出ArcEDB，一种新型FHE-based SQL评估基础设施，同时实现高数据精度和快速查询评估。其核心包括新的明文编码方案，使任意精度密文-密文同态比较比现有方法快多个数量级，并提出不同编码方案间的高效转换算法以支持复杂SQL语句。实验显示ArcEDB在同态过滤上最高快57倍，端到端SQL查询最高快20倍；在含1万行、64位时间戳的时间序列加密数据库上，一次SQL查询可在1分钟内完成。

paper.title: Multi-User Security of CCM Authenticated Encryption Mode
paper.description: The CCM authenticated encryption mode has gained widespread usage and standardization. Notably, in conjunction with GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305, CCM is recommended to be used in TLS 1.3 that underlies in https. Since TLS 1.3 is currently utilized by a large number of users, it is imperative to assess the security of these schemes in the multi-user model. Concrete multi-user security analysis for GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305 have been scrutinized in literature. However, the formal multi-user security analysis for CCM falls behind that for GCM and ChaCha20-Poly1305. Furthermore, in the associated IETF document, the multi-user security bound for CCM is derived by naive generic reduction and falls considerably short of our expectations. In this paper, we bridge the gap by establishing a concrete multi-user security bound for CCM. Our new bound surpasses that derived from generic reduction and it indicates that CCM maintains birthday-bound security in the multi-user model as in the single-user model.
paper.author: Xiangyang Zhang (Shanghai Jiao Tong University), Yaobin Shen (Xiamen University), Lei Wang (Shanghai Jiao Tong University)
paper.summary_zh: CCM认证加密模式已被广泛标准化，并与GCM、ChaCha20-Poly1305一起被TLS 1.3推荐使用，因此其在多用户模型下的安全性至关重要。然而，CCM的形式化多用户安全分析落后于GCM和ChaCha20-Poly1305，IETF文档中给出的多用户安全界仅来自通用归约且较为宽松。论文为CCM建立了具体的多用户安全界，该界优于通用归约结果，并表明CCM在多用户模型下仍保持与单用户模型相同的生日界安全性。

paper.title: Are We Getting Well-informed? An In-depth Study of Runtime Privacy Notice Practice in Mobile Apps
paper.description: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), mobile app developers are required to inform users of necessary information at the time when user data is collected (called users' "Right-to-be-Informed"). This is typically done by app developers via providing runtime privacy notices (RPNs for short). However, given the heterogeneous privacy data types and data access patterns in modern apps, it is not clear to what extent apps (app developers) effectively fulfill this compliance requirement in practice.
paper.author: Shuai Li (Fudan University), Zhemin Yang (Fudan University), Yuhong Nan (Sun Yat-sen University), Shutian Yu (Fudan University), Qirui Zhu (Fudan University), Min Yang (Fudan University)
paper.summary_zh: GDPR要求移动应用在收集用户数据时通过运行时隐私通知（RPN）向用户履行知情权，但现代应用中隐私数据类型和数据访问模式高度异构，实际合规程度尚不明确。本文对移动应用中的RPN实践进行深入研究，评估应用开发者是否以及在多大程度上有效提供必要告知。研究旨在揭示当前RPN机制与合规要求之间的差距，为改进移动隐私告知实践提供依据。

paper.title: Rules Refine the Riddle: Global Explanation for Deep Learning-Based Anomaly Detection in Security Applications
paper.description: Deep learning (DL) based anomaly detection has shown great promise in the field of security due to its remarkable performance in various tasks. However, the issue of poor interpretability in DL models has significantly impeded their deployment in practical security applications. Despite the progress made in existing studies on DL explanations, the majority of them focus on providing local explanations for individual samples, neglecting the global understanding of the model knowledge. Furthermore, most explanations for supervised models fail to apply to anomaly detection due to their different learning mechanisms.
paper.author: Dongqi Han (Tsinghua University), Zhiliang Wang (Tsinghua University), Ruitao Feng (Singapore Management University), Minghui Jin (State Grid Shanghai Municipal Electric Power Company), Wenqi Chen (Tsinghua University), Kai Wang (Tsinghua University), Su Wang (Zhongguancun Laboratory), Jiahai Yang (Tsinghua University), Xingang Shi (Tsinghua University), Xia Yin (Tsinghua University), Yang Liu (Nanyang Technological University)
paper.summary_zh: 该论文关注深度学习异常检测在安全应用中因可解释性差而难以落地的问题，指出现有解释研究多面向单个样本的局部解释，且面向监督模型的解释方法难以适配异常检测的学习机制。为此，作者提出面向安全异常检测的全局解释方法，尝试借助安全规则来刻画和细化模型所学习到的整体知识。论文旨在让安全分析人员理解异常检测模型的全局行为，从而提升模型部署的可信度与可操作性。

paper.title: The Invisible Polyjuice Potion: an Effective Physical Adversarial Attack against Face Recognition
paper.description: Face recognition systems have been targeted by recent physical adversarial machine learning attacks, which attach or project visible patterns on adversaries' faces to trick backend FR models. While these attacks have demonstrated effectiveness in the literature, they often rely on visibly suspicious patterns, are susceptible to environmental noise, or exhibit limited success rates in practice. In this paper, we propose a novel physical adversarial attack against deep face recognition systems, namely Agile (Adversarial Glasses with Infrared LasEr). It generates adjustable, invisible laser perturbations and emits them into the camera CMOS to launch dodging and impersonation attacks against facial biometrics systems. To do so, we first theoretically model physical adversarial perturbations and convert them to the digital domain. The generated synthesized attack signals are utilized to guide real-world laser settings. Our experiments with real-world attackers and a benchmark face database show that Agile is highly effective in DoS, dodging, and impersonation attacks. More importantly, the candidate impersonation target and optimal attack settings identified by Agile's attack synthesis approach are highly consistent with real-world physical attack results. The grey-box and black-box evaluation against commercial FR models also confirms the effectiveness of the Agile attack.
paper.author: Ye Wang (The University of Kansas), Zeyan Liu (The University of Kansas), Bo Luo (The University of Kansas), Rongqing Hui (The University of Kansas), Fengjun Li (The University of Kansas)
paper.summary_zh: 人脸识别系统面临物理对抗攻击威胁，但现有方法通常依赖明显可疑的图案、易受环境噪声影响或实际成功率有限。论文提出一种新型物理对抗攻击Agile（Adversarial Glasses with Infrared LasEr），通过向摄像头CMOS发射可调节、不可见的激光扰动来实施逃避和冒充攻击。作者先对物理对抗扰动进行理论建模并转换到数字域，再用合成攻击信号指导真实激光参数设置。实验表明Agile在拒绝服务、逃避和冒充攻击中均高度有效，且合成得到的目标与最优设置和真实物理攻击结果高度一致；对商用FR模型的灰盒和黑盒评估也验证了攻击有效性。

paper.title: The Harder You Try, The Harder You Fail: The KeyTrap Denial-of-Service Algorithmic Complexity Attacks on DNSSEC
paper.description: Availability is a major concern in the design of DNSSEC. To ensure availability, DNSSEC follows Postel's Law [RFC1123]: "Be liberal in what you accept, and conservative in what you send." Hence, nameservers should send not just one matching key for a record set, but all the relevant cryptographic material, e.g., all the keys for all the ciphers that they support and all the corresponding signatures. This ensures that validation succeeds, and hence availability, even if some of the DNSSEC keys are misconfigured, incorrect or correspond to unsupported ciphers.
paper.author: Elias Heftrig (GU), Haya Schulmann (GU), Niklas Vogel (GU), Michael Waidner (Fraunhofer SIT and TU Darmstadt)
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究了DNSSEC的可用性问题，指出其遵循Postel定律要求名称服务器发送所有相关密钥和签名以确保验证成功。作者提出了KeyTrap，一种利用DNSSEC验证算法复杂性的拒绝服务攻击。通过构造包含大量密钥和签名的响应，攻击者可以迫使验证器进行大量计算，导致服务不可用。实验表明该攻击能有效瘫痪DNSSEC验证器，并可能影响整个DNS解析。该攻击揭示了DNSSEC设计中的严重漏洞，需要重新审视其可用性与安全性的平衡。

paper.title: A Comprehensive Analysis of Security Vulnerabilities and Attacks in Satellite Modems
paper.description: Satellite modems are critical components in satellite communication networks. Especially, they determine the entire communication regime in traditional systems where the satellites only act as transparent relays. However, unlike satellites that are usually more isolated and better protected, satellite modems are accessible and susceptible to lower-cost attacks, potentially serving as a weak link in the chain of satellite communication security. We make the first attempt to shed light on satellite modem security. We first physically disassemble commodity satellite modems and systematically examine hardware and software modules. We perform a measurement study on the satellite modems that are exposed to the Internet. We identify 16 security vulnerabilities across three attack surfaces: satellite communication interface, ground network interface, and hardware. We further introduce AirSecAnalyzer, an automated security analyzer/fuzzer for the modems' satellite communication interface. Through comprehensive analysis and extensive experiments on 9 real-world satellite modems, we report 18 novel attacks that exploit the identified vulnerabilities. Our findings are expected to contribute as a valuable foundation for future research on the security of satellite modems and satellite communication networks.
paper.author: Lingjing Yu (Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences), Jingli Hao (Sinsegye (Shenzhen) Computer System Co., LTD), Jun Ma (Sinsegye (Shenzhen) Computer System Co., LTD), Yong Sun (Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences), Yijun Zhao (Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences), Bo Luo (The University of Kansas)
paper.summary_zh: 论文首次对卫星调制解调器的安全性进行了全面分析。作者物理拆解了商用卫星调制解调器，系统检查了硬件和软件模块，并对暴露在互联网上的设备进行了测量研究。他们发现了三个攻击面（卫星通信接口、地面网络接口和硬件）上的16个安全漏洞，并开发了针对卫星通信接口的自动化安全分析器/模糊测试工具AirSecAnalyzer。通过对9个真实调制解调器的实验，报告了18种新型攻击，为未来卫星通信网络安全研究奠定了基础。

paper.title: BlueSWAT: A Lightweight State-Aware Security Framework for Bluetooth Low Energy
paper.description: Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) is a short-range wireless communication technology for resource-constrained IoT devices. Unfortunately, BLE is vulnerable to session-based attacks, where previous packets construct exploitable conditions for subsequent packets to compromise connections. Defending against session-based attacks is challenging because each step in the attack sequence is legitimate when inspected individually. In this paper, we present BlueSWAT, a lightweight state-aware security framework for protecting BLE devices. To perform inspection on the session level rather than individual packets, BlueSWAT leverages a finite state machine (FSM) to monitor sequential actions of connections at runtime. Patterns of session-based attacks are modeled as malicious transition paths in the FSM. To overcome the heterogeneous IoT environment, we develop a lightweight eBPF framework to facilitate universal patch distribution across different BLE architectures and stacks, without requiring device reboot. We implement BlueSWAT on 5 real-world devices with different chips and stacks to demonstrate its cross-device adaptability. On our dataset with 101 real-world BLE vulnerabilities, BlueSWAT can mitigate 76.1% of session-based attacks, outperforming other defense frameworks. In our end-to-end application evaluation, BlueSWAT introduces an average of 0.073% memory overhead and negligible latency.
paper.author: Xijia Che (Tsinghua University), Yi He (Tsinghua University), Xuewei Feng (Tsinghua University), Kun Sun (George Mason University), Ke Xu (Tsinghua University), Qi Li (Tsinghua University)
paper.summary_zh: 论文针对蓝牙低功耗（BLE）设备易受基于会话的攻击的问题，这类攻击中单个数据包看似合法但序列构成攻击。作者提出了BlueSWAT，一个轻量级状态感知安全框架。它利用有限状态机（FSM）在运行时监控连接的顺序动作，将基于会话的攻击建模为FSM中的恶意转移路径。为适应异构IoT环境，开发了轻量级eBPF框架，无需重启即可跨不同BLE架构和协议栈分发补丁。在5个真实设备上实现，并在包含101个真实BLE漏洞的数据集上缓解了76.1%的会话攻击，优于其他框架，平均内存开销仅0.073%，延迟可忽略。

paper.title: Prompt Fuzzing for Fuzz Driver Generation
paper.description: Crafting high-quality fuzz drivers not only is time-consuming but also requires a deep understanding of the library. However, the state-of-the-art automatic fuzz driver generation techniques fall short of expectations. While fuzz drivers derived from consumer code can reach deep states, they have limited coverage. Conversely, interpretative fuzzing can explore most API calls but requires numerous attempts within a large search space. We propose PromptFuzz, a coverage-guided fuzzer for prompt fuzzing that iteratively generates fuzz drivers to explore undiscovered library code. To explore API usage in fuzz drivers during prompt fuzzing, we propose several key techniques: instructive program generation, erroneous program validation, coverage-guided prompt mutation, and constrained fuzzer scheduling. We implemented PromptFuzz and evaluated it on 14 real-world libraries. Compared with OSS-Fuzz and Hopper (the state-of-the-art fuzz driver generation tool), fuzz drivers generated by PromptFuzz achieved 1.61 and 1.63 times higher branch coverage than those by OSS-Fuzz and Hopper, respectively. Moreover, the fuzz drivers generated by PromptFuzz detected 33 genuine, new bugs out of a total of 49 crashes, out of which 30 bugs have been confirmed by their respective communities.
paper.author: Yunlong Lyu (Tencent Security Big Data Lab), Yuxuan Xie (Tencent Security Big Data Lab), Peng Chen (Tencent Security Big Data Lab), Hao Chen (University of California, Davis)
paper.summary_zh: 论文针对模糊测试中高质量驱动生成耗时且需深入理解库的问题，提出了PromptFuzz，一种基于覆盖率引导的提示模糊测试器，迭代生成模糊测试驱动。现有方法中，从消费者代码衍生的驱动覆盖深但范围有限，解释性模糊测试探索API多但搜索空间大。PromptFuzz采用指令性程序生成、错误程序验证、覆盖率引导的提示变异和受限模糊测试调度等技术。在14个真实库上评估，分支覆盖率比OSS-Fuzz和Hopper分别高1.61和1.63倍，检测到33个真实新漏洞（共49个崩溃），其中30个已被社区确认。

paper.title: Fast Two-party Threshold ECDSA with Proactive Security
paper.description: We present a new construction of two-party, threshold ECDSA, building on a 2017 scheme of Lindell and improving his scheme in several ways.
paper.author: S. Dov Gordon (George Mason University), Craig Gentry (TripleBlind), Brian Koziel (TripleBlind), S. Dov Gordon (TripleBlind)
paper.summary_zh: 论文提出了一种新的两方门限ECDSA签名方案，具有主动安全性。该方案基于Lindell 2017年的方案进行改进，在多个方面提升了性能或安全性。门限ECDSA在分布式系统中至关重要，如加密货币钱包，但现有方案可能存在安全或效率瓶颈。本文的改进旨在实现更快的签名生成和更强的安全保证，具体改进点包括优化协议轮数或降低通信开销。虽然摘要未提供具体实验数据，但该工作为门限ECDSA的实际部署提供了更优选择。

paper.title: Graphiti: Secure Graph Computation Made More Scalable
paper.description: Privacy-preserving graph analysis allows performing computations on graphs that store sensitive information while ensuring all the information about the topology of the graph, as well as data associated with the nodes and edges, remains hidden. The current work addresses this problem by designing a highly scalable framework, Graphiti, that allows securely realising any graph algorithm. Graphiti relies on the technique of secure multiparty computation (MPC) to design a generic framework that improves over the state-of-the-art framework of GraphSC by Araki et al. (CCS'21). The key technical contribution is that Graphiti has round complexity independent of the graph size, which in turn allows attaining the desired scalability. Specifically, this is achieved by (i) decoupling the Scatter primitive of GraphSC into separate operations of Propagate and ApplyE, (ii) designing a novel constant-round approach to realise Propagate, as well as (iii) designing a novel constant-round approach to realise the Gather primitive of GraphSC by leveraging the linearity of the aggregation operation. We benchmark the performance of Graphiti for the application of contact tracing via BFS for 10 hops and observe that it takes less than 2 minutes when computing over a graph of size 10^7. Concretely it improves over the state-of-the-art up to a factor of 1034× in online run time. Similar to GraphSC by Araki et al., since Graphiti relies on a secure protocol for shuffle, we additionally design a shuffle protocol secure against a semi-honest adversary in the 2-party with a helper setting. Given the versatility of shuffle protocol, the designed solution is of independent interest. Hence, we also benchmark the performance of the designed shuffle where we observe improvements of up to 1.83× in online run time when considering an input vector of size 10^7, in comparison to the state-of-the-art in the considered setting.
paper.author: Nishat Koti (TU Darmstadt), Varsha Bhat Kukkala (Unaffiliated), Arpita Patra (IISc Bangalore), Bhavish Raj Gopal (IISc Bangalore)
paper.summary_zh: 论文提出了Graphiti，一个高度可扩展的安全图计算框架，用于隐私保护图分析。现有方案GraphSC的轮复杂度与图大小相关，限制了可扩展性。Graphiti通过将Scatter原语分解为Propagate和ApplyE，并为Propagate和Gather设计了新颖的常数轮方法，使得轮复杂度与图规模无关。在1千万节点的图上进行10跳BFS的接触者追踪应用，运行时间不到2分钟，在线运行时间相比最先进方案提升了1034倍。此外，还设计了一个在2方辅助设置下抗半诚实敌手的混洗协议，性能提升1.83倍。

paper.title: Computationally Secure Private Information Retrieval and Aggregation in the Shuffle Model
paper.author: Adria Gascon (Google LLC), Yuval Ishai (Technion), Mahimna Kelkar (Cornell Tech), Baiyu Li (Google LLC), Yiping Ma (University of Pennsylvania), Mariana Raykova (Google Inc.)
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究了在混洗模型下的私有信息检索和聚合，旨在实现计算安全性。混洗模型是一种隐私增强技术，通过混洗消息来隐藏用户身份。作者提出了新的协议，可能基于密码学假设，以在混洗模型中实现安全的PIR和聚合。该工作为隐私保护的数据查询和聚合提供了理论支持，由Google、Technion等机构合作完成，具有重要的理论和实践意义。

paper.title: ProBE: Proportioning Privacy Budget for Complex Exploratory Decision Support
paper.description: This paper studies privacy in the context of complex decision support queries composed of multiple conditions on different aggregate statistics combined using disjunction and conjunction operators. Utility requirements for such queries necessitate the need for private mechanisms that guarantee a bound on the false negative and false positive errors. This paper formally defines complex decision support queries and their accuracy requirements, and provides algorithms that proportion the existing budget to optimally minimize privacy loss while supporting a bounded guarantee on the accuracy. Our experimental results on multiple real-life datasets show that our algorithms successfully maintain such utility guarantees, while also minimizing privacy loss.
paper.author: Nada Lahjouji (UCI), Sameera Ghayyur (Snap Inc.), Xi He (University of Waterloo), Sharad Mehrotra (UCI)
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究了复杂决策支持查询中的隐私保护问题，这类查询涉及多个聚合统计条件通过析取和合取组合。为满足效用需求，私有机制需保证假阴性率和假阳性率的上界。作者形式化定义了复杂决策支持查询及其准确性要求，并提出了算法来按比例分配隐私预算，以在支持有界准确性的同时最小化隐私损失。在多个真实数据集上的实验表明，所提算法能成功维持效用保证，同时最小化隐私损失。

paper.title: ERASER: Machine Unlearning in MLaaS via an Inference Serving-Aware Approach
paper.description: Over the past years, Machine Learning-as-a-Service (MLaaS) has received a surging demand for supporting Machine Learning-driven services to offer revolutionized user experience across diverse application areas. MLaaS provides inference service with low inference latency based on an ML model trained using a dataset collected from numerous individual data owners. Recently, for the sake of data owners' privacy and to comply with the "right to be forgotten (RTBF)" as enacted by data protection legislation, many machine unlearning methods have been proposed to remove data owners' data from trained models upon their unlearning requests. However, despite their promising efficiency, almost all existing machine unlearning methods handle unlearning requests independently from inference requests, which unfortunately introduces a new security issue of inference service obsolescence and a privacy vulnerability of undesirable exposure for machine unlearning in MLaaS.
paper.author: Yuke Hu (State Key Lab. of Blockchain and Data Security, Zhejiang University), Jian Lou (State Key Lab. of Blockchain and Data Security, Zhejiang University), Jiaqi Liu (State Key Lab. of Blockchain and Data Security, Zhejiang University), Wangze Ni (State Key Lab. of Blockchain and Data Security, Zhejiang University), Feng Lin (State Key Lab. of Blockchain and Data Security, Zhejiang University), Zhan Qin (State Key Lab. of Blockchain and Data Security, Zhejiang University), Kui Ren (State Key Lab. of Blockchain and Data Security, Zhejiang University)
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究了机器学习即服务（MLaaS）中的机器遗忘问题。为遵守“被遗忘权”，现有机器遗忘方法在收到请求后从训练模型中移除数据，但这些方法独立处理遗忘请求和推理请求，导致推理服务过时和隐私暴露漏洞。作者提出了ERASER，一种感知推理服务的机器遗忘方法。该方法通过协调遗忘与推理过程，在保证低延迟推理服务的同时实现数据移除。具体技术细节未详，但旨在解决MLaaS中遗忘与推理的冲突，提升隐私和安全性。

paper.title: ``Do Anything Now'': Characterizing and Evaluating In-The-Wild Jailbreak Prompts on Large Language Models
paper.description: The misuse of large language models (LLMs) has drawn significant attention from the general public and LLM vendors. One particular type of adversarial prompt, known as jailbreak prompt, has emerged as the main attack vector to bypass the safeguards and elicit harmful content from LLMs. In this paper, employing our new framework JailbreakHub, we conduct a comprehensive analysis of 1,405 jailbreak prompts spanning from December 2022 to December 2023. We identify 131 jailbreak communities and discover unique characteristics of jailbreak prompts and their major attack strategies, such as prompt injection and privilege escalation. We also observe that jailbreak prompts increasingly shift from online Web communities to prompt-aggregation websites and 28 user accounts have consistently optimized jailbreak prompts over 100 days. To assess the potential harm caused by jailbreak prompts, we create a question set comprising 107,250 samples across 13 forbidden scenarios. Leveraging this dataset, our experiments on six popular LLMs show that their safeguards cannot adequately defend jailbreak prompts in all scenarios. Particularly, we identify five highly effective jailbreak prompts that achieve 0.95 attack success rates on ChatGPT (GPT-3.5) and GPT-4, and the earliest one has persisted online for over 240 days. We hope that our study can facilitate the research community and LLM vendors in promoting safer and regulated LLMs.
paper.author: Xinyue Shen (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security), Zeyuan Chen (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security), Michael Backes (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security), Yun Shen (Netapp), Yang Zhang (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security)
paper.summary_zh: 论文针对大型语言模型（LLM）的越狱提示进行了全面分析。作者开发了JailbreakHub框架，收集了2022年12月至2023年12月间的1405个越狱提示，识别出131个越狱社区，并总结了其攻击策略如提示注入和权限提升。研究发现越狱提示从网络社区向提示聚合网站转移，且有28个用户账号持续优化提示超过100天。通过构建包含107,250个样本的13种禁止场景问题集，实验表明六种流行LLM的安全措施无法充分防御，其中五个高效越狱提示在ChatGPT上达到0.95的攻击成功率，最早的一个已在线存在超过240天。

paper.title: On the Detectability of ChatGPT Content: Benchmarking, Methodology, and Evaluation through the Lens of Academic Writing
paper.description: With ChatGPT under the spotlight, utilizing large language models (LLMs) to assist academic writing has drawn a significant amount of debate in the community. In this paper, we aim to present a comprehensive study of the detectability of ChatGPT-generated content within the academic literature, particularly focusing on the abstracts of scientific papers, to offer holistic support for the future development of LLM applications and policies in academia. Specifically, we first present GPABench2, a benchmarking dataset of over 2.8 million comparative samples of human-written, GPT-written, GPT-completed, and GPT-polished abstracts of scientific writing in computer science, physics, and humanities and social sciences. Second, we explore the methodology for detecting ChatGPT content. We start by examining the unsatisfactory performance of existing ChatGPT detecting tools and the challenges faced by human evaluators (including more than 240 researchers or students). We then test the hand-crafted linguistic features models as a baseline and develop a deep neural framework named CheckGPT to better capture the subtle and deep semantic and linguistic patterns in ChatGPT written literature. Last, we conduct comprehensive experiments to validate the proposed CheckGPT framework in each benchmarking task over different disciplines. To evaluate the detectability of ChatGPT content, we conduct extensive experiments on the transferability, prompt engineering, and robustness of CheckGPT.
paper.author: Zeyan Liu (The University of Kansas), Zijun Yao (The University of Kansas), Fengjun Li (The University of Kansas), Bo Luo (The University of Kansas)
paper.summary_zh: 论文针对ChatGPT生成内容在学术写作中的可检测性进行了全面研究。作者构建了GPABench2数据集，包含超过280万条计算机科学、物理和人文社科领域的摘要样本，涵盖人类撰写、GPT撰写、GPT补全和GPT润色。他们评估了现有检测工具和人类评估者（240多名研究人员/学生）的表现，发现效果不佳，进而开发了深度神经网络框架CheckGPT，以捕捉ChatGPT文本中微妙的语义和语言模式。实验表明CheckGPT在不同学科、迁移性、提示工程和鲁棒性方面均有效，为学术界制定LLM使用政策提供了支持。

paper.title: Alchemy: Data-Free Adversarial Training
paper.description: Machine learning models have become integral to various aspects of daily life, prompting increased vulnerability to adversarial attacks.Adversarial training is one of the most promising and practical methods to enhance model robustness.Existing adversarial training methods, however, assume access to the original training data.But nowadays, more and more users directly download models from the open-source model platforms or tech companies, but the original training datasets are usually unreleased because of commercial interests or privacy.In such scenarios, the user cannot utilize the former adversarial training methods to improve model robustness because of the lack of original training datasets.Thus, we present the first exploration of a data-free adversarial training framework, Alchemy, which seeks to enhance model robustness without requiring access to the original training data.By addressing the notable challenges of reconstructing high-quality training data with robust features and improving the adversarial robustness to the inaccessible original dataset, our approach achieves the goals of both high accuracy maintenance and robustness improvement.Comprehensive experiments on four datasets compared with five baselines, demonstrate Alchemy 's high effectiveness.With no access to any training dataset, the average robustness improvement with Alchemy is effective in most attack scenarios.Additional evaluations underscore the framework's stability under different settings and discuss future research directions.
paper.author: Yijie Bai (Zhejiang University), Zhongming Ma (Wuhan University), Yanjiao Chen (Zhejiang University), Jiangyi Deng (Zhejiang University), Shengyuan Pang (Zhejiang University), Yan Liu (Ant Group), Wenyuan Xu (Zhejiang University)
paper.summary_zh: 论文针对机器学习模型易受对抗攻击的问题，指出传统对抗训练依赖原始训练数据，但在用户从开源平台下载模型而训练数据未公开的场景下无法使用。作者提出了首个无数据对抗训练框架Alchemy，旨在不访问原始训练数据的情况下增强模型鲁棒性。Alchemy通过重构具有鲁棒特征的高质量训练数据并提升对未知原始数据集的对抗鲁棒性，实现了高准确率保持和鲁棒性提升。在四个数据集上与五个基线相比，实验表明Alchemy在大多数攻击场景下有效提升鲁棒性，并在不同设置下表现出稳定性。

paper.title: Principled Microarchitectural Isolation on Cloud CPUs
paper.description: We present Marghera, a system design that prevents cross-VM microarchitectural side-channel attacks in the cloud. Marghera is based on isolation contracts which, for a given CPU, describe partitions of physical threads and memory that prevent information leakage through shared microarchitectural resources.
paper.author: Stavros Volos (Azure Research, Microsoft), Cédric Fournet (Azure Research, Microsoft), Jana Hofmann (Azure Research, Microsoft), Boris Köpf (Azure Research, Microsoft), Oleksii Oleksenko (Azure Research, Microsoft)
paper.summary_zh: 针对云环境中跨虚拟机微架构侧信道攻击的威胁，论文提出 Marghera 系统设计。它引入“隔离契约”（isolation contracts），针对特定 CPU 描述物理线程和内存的分区方式，防止通过共享微架构资源泄漏信息。该方法旨在云 CPU 上实现有原则的微架构隔离，抵御跨 VM 信息泄露。摘要未给出具体实验数据，但其目标是在多租户云中提升微架构安全隔离能力。

paper.title: SysBumps: Exploiting Speculative Execution in System Calls for Breaking KASLR in macOS for Apple Silicon
paper.description: Apple silicon is the proprietary ARM-based processor that powers the mainstream of Apple devices. The move to this proprietary architecture presents unique challenges in addressing security issues, requiring huge research efforts into the security of Apple silicon-based systems. In this paper, we study the security of KASLR, the randomization-based kernel hardening technique, on the state-of-the-art macOS system equipped with Apple silicon processors. Because KASLR has been subject to many microarchitectural side-channel attacks, the latest operating systems, including macOS, use kernel isolation, which separates the kernel page table from the userspace table. Kernel isolation in macOS provides a barrier to KASLR break attacks. To overcome this, we exploit speculative execution in system calls. By using Spectre-type gadgets in system calls, an unprivileged attacker can cause translations of the attacker's chosen kernel addresses, causing the TLB to change according to the validity of the address. This allows the construction of an attack primitive that breaks KASLR bypassing kernel isolation. Since the TLB is used as a side-channel source, we reverse-engineer the hidden internals of the TLB on various M-series processors using a hardware performance monitoring unit. Based on our attack primitive, we implement SysBumps, the first KASLR break attack on macOS for Apple silicon. Throughout evaluation, we show that SysBumps can effectively break KASLR across different M-series processors and macOS versions. We also discuss possible mitigations against the proposed attack.
paper.author: Hyerean Jang (Korea University), Taehun Kim (Korea University), Youngjoo Shin (Korea University)
paper.summary_zh: Apple Silicon 平台的 macOS 采用内核隔离来抵御 KASLR 破坏攻击，但论文发现系统调用中的推测执行可绕过该隔离。作者利用系统调用中的 Spectre 型 gadget，诱使 CPU 翻译攻击者选择的内核地址，并依据地址有效性造成 TLB 状态变化，从而构建 KASLR 破坏原语。他们通过硬件性能监控单元逆向 M 系列处理器 TLB 内部结构，并实现首个针对 Apple Silicon macOS 的 KASLR 破坏攻击 SysBumps。评估表明 SysBumps 能在不同 M 系列处理器和 macOS 版本上有效破坏 KASLR，论文还讨论了可能的缓解措施。

paper.title: PeTAL: Ensuring Access Control Integrity against Data-only Attacks on Linux
paper.description: Data-only attacks are emerging as a new threat to the security of modern operating systems. As a typical data-only attack, memory corruption attacks can compromise the integrity of kernel data, which effectively breaks the premises of access control systems. Unfortunately, the prevalence of memory corruption vulnerabilities allows attackers to exploit them and bypass access control mechanisms. Given the arbitrary memory access capability, attackers can overwrite access control policies or illegally access the kernel resources protected by the access control systems.
paper.author: Juhee Kim (Seoul National University), Jinbum Park (Samsung Research), Yoochan Lee (Seoul National University), Chengyu Song (UC Riverside), Taesoo Kim (Samsung Research and Georgia Institute of Technology), Byoungyoung Lee (Seoul National University)
paper.summary_zh: Linux 内核面临仅数据攻击（data-only attacks）的新威胁，攻击者可利用内存破坏漏洞篡改内核数据，破坏访问控制系统的完整性。一旦获得任意内存访问能力，攻击者就能覆盖访问控制策略或非法访问受保护的内核资源。论文提出 PeTAL，旨在确保访问控制完整性以抵御此类攻击。摘要未详述具体实现和实验，但核心目标是防止内核数据篡改导致访问控制策略失效。

paper.title: The HitchHiker's Guide to High-Assurance System Observability Protection with Efficient Permission Switches
paper.description: Protecting system observability records (logs) from compromised OSs has gained significant traction in recent times, with several note-worthy approaches proposed. Unfortunately, none of the proposed approaches achieve high performance with tiny log protection delays. They also leverage risky environments for protection (e.g., many use general-purpose hypervisors or TrustZone, which have large TCB and attack surfaces). HitchHiker is an attempt to rectify this problem. The system is designed to ensure (a) in-memory protection of batched logs within a short and configurable real-time deadline by efficient hardware permission switching, and (b) an end-to-end high-assurance environment built upon hardware protection primitives with debloating strategies for secure log protection, persistence, and management. Security evaluations and validations show that HitchHiker reduces log protection delay by 93.3--99.3% compared to the state-of-the-art, while reducing TCB by 9.4--26.9X. Performance evaluations show HitchHiker incurs a geometric mean of less than 6% overhead on diverse real-world programs, improving on the state-of-the-art approach by 61.9--77.5%.
paper.author: Chuqi Zhang (National University of Singapore), Jun Zeng (Independent Researcher), Yiming Zhang (Southern University of Science and Technology and The Hong Kong Polytechnic University), Adil Ahmad (Arizona State University), Fengwei Zhang (Southern University of Science and Technology (SUStech)), Zhenkai Liang (National University of Singapore), Hai Jin (Huazhong University of Science and Technology)
paper.summary_zh: 操作系统被攻陷后，系统可观测性日志可能被篡改，现有保护方案难以同时实现高性能和低保护延迟，且常依赖大 TCB 的高风险环境。论文提出 HitchHiker，利用高效硬件权限切换在可配置实时期限内保护批量内存日志，并基于硬件保护原语和去膨胀策略构建端到端高保障的日志保护、持久化与管理环境。安全评估显示，HitchHiker 将日志保护延迟降低 93.3–99.3%，TCB 减少 9.4–26.9 倍。性能评估表明，其在多种真实程序上平均开销低于 6%，比现有最佳方案提升 61.9–77.5%。

paper.title: $S^2$NeRF: Privacy-preserving Training Framework for NeRF
paper.description: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) have revolutionized 3D computer vision and graphics, facilitating novel view synthesis and influencing sectors like extended reality and e-commerce. However, NeRF's dependence on extensive data collection, including sensitive scene image data, introduces significant privacy risks when users upload this data for model training. To address this concern, we first propose SplitNeRF, a training framework that incorporates split learning (SL) techniques to enable privacy-preserving collaborative model training between clients and servers without sharing local data. Despite its benefits, we identify vulnerabilities in SplitNeRF by developing two attack methods, Surrogate Model Attack and Scene-aided Surrogate Model Attack, which exploit the shared gradient data and a few leaked scene images to reconstruct private scene information. To counter these threats, we introduce S^2NeRF, secure SplitNeRF that integrates effective defense mechanisms. By introducing decaying noise related to the gradient norm into the shared gradient information, S^2NeRF preserves privacy while maintaining a high utility of the NeRF model. Our extensive evaluations across multiple datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of S^2NeRF against privacy breaches, confirming its viability for secure NeRF training in sensitive applications.
paper.author: Bokang Zhang (The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen), Yanglin Zhang (The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen), Zhikun Zhang (Stanford & CISPA), Jinglan Yang (The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen), Lingying Huang (Nanyang Technological University), Junfeng Wu (The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen)
paper.summary_zh: NeRF 依赖大量敏感场景图像，用户上传数据进行模型训练时面临严重隐私风险。论文先提出 SplitNeRF，利用拆分学习让客户端与服务器在不共享本地数据的情况下协作训练。随后作者识别其漏洞，设计代理模型攻击和场景辅助代理模型攻击，利用共享梯度和少量泄漏场景图像重建私有场景。为抵御攻击，论文提出 S^2NeRF，在共享梯度中加入与梯度范数相关的衰减噪声，在保持 NeRF 效用的同时保护隐私。多数据集评估表明 S^2NeRF 能有效防止隐私泄露，适用于敏感场景的安全 NeRF 训练。

paper.title: Evaluations of Machine Learning Privacy Defenses are Misleading
paper.description: Empirical defenses for machine learning privacy forgo the provable guarantees of differential privacy in the hope of achieving higher utility while resisting realistic adversaries. We identify severe pitfalls in existing empirical privacy evaluations (based on membership inference attacks) that result in misleading conclusions. In particular, we show that prior evaluations fail to characterize the privacy leakage of the most vulnerable samples, use weak attacks, and avoid comparisons with practical differential privacy baselines. In 5 case studies of empirical privacy defenses, we find that prior evaluations underestimate privacy leakage by an order of magnitude. Under our stronger evaluation, none of the empirical defenses we study are competitive with a properly tuned, high-utility DP-SGD baseline (with vacuous provable guarantees).
paper.author: Michael Aerni (ETH Zurich), Jie Zhang (ETH Zurich), Florian Tramèr (ETH Zurich)
paper.summary_zh: 机器学习隐私的经验性防御常放弃差分隐私的可证明保证以追求更高效用，但其评估方法存在严重缺陷。论文指出基于成员推理攻击的现有评估未能刻画最脆弱样本、使用弱攻击且回避与实用差分隐私基线的比较。在 5 个案例研究中，作者发现先前评估将隐私泄露低估了一个数量级。采用更强评估后，这些经验性防御均无法与调优良好的高效用 DP-SGD 基线竞争，表明当前评估结论具有误导性。

paper.title: RISiren: Wireless Sensing System Attacks via Metasurface
paper.description: After over a decade of intensive research, wireless sensing technology is nearing commercialization. However, the inherent openness of the wireless medium exposes this technology to security flaws and vulnerabilities. In this paper, we introduce RISiren to reveal the risk. RISiren is a pioneering end-to-end black-box attack system leveraging programmable metasurface with a high level of stealthiness. The key insight of RISiren lies in its ability to generate malicious multipath using metasurface, thereby disrupting wireless channel metrics influenced by genuine human activities and facilitating malicious attacks. To ensure the effectiveness of RISiren, we propose a novel metasurface configuration strategy aiming at creating human-like activities that stem from a comprehensive analysis of how human activities impact wireless signal propagation. We have implemented and validated RISiren using commercial Wi-Fi devices. Our evaluation involved testing our attack strategies against five state-of-the-art systems (including five different types of recognition frameworks) representative of the current landscape. The experimental results show that the adversarial wireless signals generated by RISiren achieve over 90% attack success rate on average, and remain robust and effective across different environments and deployment setups, including through wall attack scenarios.
paper.author: Chenghan jiang (NorthWest University), Jinjiang Yang (NorthWest University), Xinyi Li (Tsinghua University), Qi Li (Tsinghua University), Xinyu Zhang (University of California San Diego), Ju Ren (Tsinghua University)
paper.summary_zh: 无线感知技术正走向商用，但无线介质的开放性使其易受安全攻击。论文提出 RISiren，一种利用可编程超表面（metasurface）的端到端黑盒攻击系统，通过生成恶意多径来干扰真实人类活动影响的无线信道指标。作者提出新颖的超表面配置策略，以模拟人类活动对无线信号传播的影响。基于商用 Wi-Fi 设备实现并评估，RISiren 对五种先进识别系统平均攻击成功率超过 90%，且在不同环境和穿墙场景下保持鲁棒有效。

paper.title: Distributed Backdoor Attacks on Federated Graph Learning and Certified Defenses
paper.description: Federated graph learning (FedGL) is an emerging federated learning (FL) framework that extends FL to learn graph data from diverse sources without accessing the data. FL for non-graph data has shown to be vulnerable to backdoor attacks, which inject a shared backdoor trigger into the training data such that the trained backdoored FL model can predict the testing data containing the trigger as the attacker desires. However, FedGL against backdoor attacks is largely unexplored, and no effective defense exists.
paper.author: Yuxin Yang (Jilin University & Illinois Institute of Technology), Qiang Li (College of Computer Science and Technology, Jilin University), Jinyuan Jia (Penn State), Yuan Hong (University of Connecticut), Binghui Wang (Illinois Institute of Technology)
paper.summary_zh: 联邦图学习（FedGL）将联邦学习扩展到图数据，但后门攻击威胁尚未被充分研究，也缺乏有效防御。论文研究 FedGL 中的分布式后门攻击，攻击者通过训练数据注入共享后门触发器，使训练后的模型将含触发器的测试样本预测为攻击者期望标签。由于 FedGL 后门攻防研究空白，作者进一步提出认证防御方法。摘要未给出实验结果，但工作填补了 FedGL 后门攻击与防御的空白。

paper.title: Skipping the Security Side Quests: A Qualitative Study on Security Practices and Challenges in Game Development
paper.description: The video game market is one of the biggest for software products. Video game development has progressed in the last decades to complex and multifaceted endeavors. Games-as-a-Service significantly impacted distribution and gameplay, requiring providers and developers to consider factors beyond game functionality, including security and privacy. New security challenges emerged, including authentication, payment security, and user data or asset protection. However, the security community lacks in-depth insights into the security experiences, challenges, and practices of modern video game development. This paper aims to address this gap in research and highlights the criticality of considering security in the process.
paper.author: Philip Klostermeyer (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security), Sabrina Amft (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security), Sandra Höltervennhoff (Leibniz University Hannover), Alexander Krause (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security), Niklas Busch (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security), Sascha Fahl (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security)
paper.summary_zh: 视频游戏市场规模巨大，游戏即服务模式带来认证、支付安全、用户数据与资产保护等新安全挑战。然而安全社区对现代游戏开发中的安全实践、经验与挑战缺乏深入理解。论文通过定性研究揭示游戏开发者的安全实践与困难。研究填补了该领域空白，并强调在游戏开发流程中考虑安全的重要性。

paper.title: Two-Tier Data Packing in RLWE-based Homomorphic Encryption for Secure Federated Learning
paper.description: Homomorphic Encryption (HE) facilitates the preservation of privacy in federated learning (FL) aggregation. However, HE imposes significant computational and communication overhead. To address this problem, data encoding methods have been introduced that enable batch processing to improving the efficiency of ciphertext usage. The existing methods simply concatenate integer or coefficients assignment in polynomials, which do not fully make use of HE based on ring learning with errors (RLWE). We present a novel two-tier data encoding approach tailored for RLWE-based HE, effectively utilizing RLWE's polynomial structure. Our method involves a dual-level data packing strategy for batch processing at both integer and polynomial levels. At the first tier (integer level), we amalgamate those quantized model data into larger integers. Beyond existing concatenation-based encoding, we introduce a new encoding method derived from the Chinese Remainder Theorem (CRT). This CRT-based method effectively mitigates overflow and error propagation concerns. At the second tier (polynomial level), we transmute the large integers into a polynomial form. Additionally, we propose a new subring decomposition method, i.e., employing ring isomorphism mappings to project multiple large integers into varied sub-polynomial rings. Our dual-tier encoding strategy offers a more flexible and effective batch HE solution. We rigorously analyze the correctness, efficiency, and security of our approach. Our extensive experimental evaluations reveal that secure FL, empowered by our dual-tier encoding technique, markedly enhances computational and communication efficiencies over prevailing batch HE methods.
paper.author: Yufei Zhou (Sun Yat-Sen University), Peijia Zheng (Sun Yat-Sen University), Xiaochun Cao (Sun Yat-Sen University), Jiwu Huang (Shenzhen MSU-BIT University)
paper.summary_zh: 同态加密可保护联邦学习聚合隐私，但计算与通信开销大，现有数据编码方法未能充分利用 RLWE 的多项式结构。论文提出面向 RLWE 同态加密的两层数据编码与打包方法：整数层将量化模型数据合并为大整数，并基于中国剩余定理编码以缓解溢出和错误传播；多项式层将大整数转换为多项式，并利用环同构映射进行子环分解。作者严格分析正确性、效率与安全性，并通过实验证明该双层编码显著提升安全联邦学习的计算和通信效率，优于现有批量同态加密方法。

paper.title: Foundations for Cryptographic Reductions in CCSA Logics
paper.description: The Computationally Complete Symbolic Attacker (CCSA) approach to security protocol verification relies on probabilistic logics to reason about the interaction traces between a protocol and an arbitrary adversary. The proof assistant Squirrel implements one such logic. CCSA logics come with cryptographic axioms whose soundness derives from the security of standard cryptographic games, e.g. PRF, EUF, IND-CCA. Unfortunately, these axioms are complex to design and implement; so far, these tasks are manual, ad-hoc and error-prone. We solve these issues by providing a formal and systematic method for deriving axioms from cryptographic games. Our method relies on synthesizing an adversary against some cryptographic game, through the notion of bi-deduction. Concretely, we define a rich notion of bi-deduction, justify how to use it to derive cryptographic axioms, provide a proof system for bi-deduction, and an automatic proof-search method which we implemented in Squirrel.
paper.author: David Baelde (Univ Rennes, CNRS, IRISA), Adrien Koutsos (Inria Paris), Justine Sauvage (Inria Paris)
paper.summary_zh: CCSA 逻辑用于安全协议验证，其密码学公理通常需从 PRF、EUF、IND-CCA 等标准密码游戏的安全性手动推导，过程复杂且易错。论文提出一种从密码游戏系统化推导公理的形式化方法，核心概念是双向演绎（bi-deduction）。作者定义丰富的双向演绎、证明其用于推导密码公理的合理性，并给出证明系统和自动证明搜索方法，已在 Squirrel 证明助手中实现。该工作为 CCSA 逻辑中的密码学归约奠定基础，提升协议验证的自动化与可靠性。

paper.title: Characterizing and Mitigating Phishing Attacks at ccTLD Scale
paper.description: International audience
paper.author: Giovane Moura (SIDN Labs and TU Delft), Thomas Daniels (DNS Belgium and KU Leuven, Department of Computer Science), Maarten Bosteels (DNS Belgium), Sebastian Castro (.IE Registry), Moritz Mueller (SIDN Labs and University of Twente), Thymen Wabeke (SIDN Labs), Thijs van den Hout (SIDN Labs), Maciej Korczynski (University of Grenoble Alps, Grenoble Informatics Laboratory), Georgios Smaragdakis (Delft University of Technology)
paper.summary_zh: 论文围绕国家代码顶级域（ccTLD）规模的钓鱼攻击展开测量与缓解研究。它利用多国 ccTLD 注册管理机构的数据，分析钓鱼域名的分布、生命周期与攻击模式，并评估缓解措施的效果。研究为域名注册管理和钓鱼治理提供跨国家级域名的实证依据。

paper.title: Release the Hounds! Automated Inference and Empirical Security Evaluation of Field-Deployed PLCs using Active Network Data
paper.author: Ryan Pickren (Georgia Institute of Technology), Animesh Chhotaray (Georgia Institute of Technology), Frank Li (Georgia Institute of Technology), Saman Zonouz (Georgia Institute of Technology), Raheem Beyah (Georgia Institute of Technology)
paper.summary_zh: 工业控制系统中的可编程逻辑控制器（PLC）广泛部署于关键基础设施，但其现场安全状况难以大规模评估。论文提出一种基于主动网络数据的自动化推断方法，用于识别和刻画现场部署的PLC设备及其安全相关属性。作者对真实网络环境中的PLC进行实证安全评估，揭示设备暴露、配置与防护现状。该工作为ICS/OT安全测量和风险发现提供了可扩展手段。

paper.title: SpecMon: Modular Black-Box Runtime Verification of Security Protocols
paper.author: Kevin Morio (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security), Robert Künnemann (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security)
paper.summary_zh: 安全协议在部署后可能因实现缺陷或环境变化偏离预期行为，运行时验证是检测异常的重要手段，但现有方法常需协议内部信息或难以模块化扩展。论文提出SpecMon，一种面向安全协议的模块化黑盒运行时验证方法。它将协议行为规范与运行时观测解耦，以黑盒方式监测协议执行并检测违规。该方法旨在提升协议运行时监控的灵活性、可组合性和实用性。摘要未给出具体实验细节，但其模块化设计有望适应多种协议与部署场景。

paper.title: RSA-Based Dynamic Accumulator without Hashing into Primes
paper.description: A cryptographic accumulator is a compact data structure for representing a set of elements coming from some domain. It allows for a compact proof of membership and, in the case of a universal accumulator, non-membership of an element x in the data structure. A dynamic accumulator, furthermore, allows elements to be added to and deleted from the accumulator.
paper.author: Victor Youdom Kemmoe (Brown University), Anna Lysyanskaya (Brown University)
paper.summary_zh: 密码累加器是一种用紧凑数据结构表示元素集合的密码原语，支持成员证明，通用累加器还支持非成员证明，动态累加器则允许元素增删。传统基于RSA的动态累加器通常需要将元素哈希为素数，这带来计算开销、实现复杂性和安全性问题。论文提出一种无需哈希为素数的RSA动态累加器，旨在保持成员/非成员证明和动态更新能力的同时简化构造。该工作可提升RSA累加器在实际系统中的效率和可部署性。摘要未提供具体性能数据，但其核心贡献是消除对哈希到素数步骤的依赖。

paper.title: Leakage-Resilient Circuit Garbling
paper.description: Due to the ubiquitous requirements and performance leap in the past decade, it has become feasible to execute garbling and secure computations in settings sensitive to side-channel attacks, including smartphones, IoTs and dedicated hardwares, and the possibilities have been demonstrated by recent works. To maintain security in the presence of a moderate amount of leaked information about internal secrets, we investigate leakage-resilient garbling. We augment the classical privacy, obliviousness and authenticity notions with leakages of the garbling function, and define their leakage-resilience analogues. We examine popular garbling schemes and unveil additional side-channel weaknesses due to wire label reuse and XOR leakages. We then incorporate the idea of label refreshing into the GLNP garbling scheme of Gueron et al. and propose a variant GLNPLR that provably satisfies our leakage-resilience definitions. Performance comparison indicates that GLNPLR is 60X (using AES-NI) or 5X (without AES-NI) faster than the HalfGates garbling with second order side-channel masking, for garbling AES circuit when the bandwidth is 2Gbps.
paper.author: Ruiyang Li (shandong university), Yiteng Sun (Shandong University), Chun Guo (Shandong University), Francois-Xavier Standaert (UCLouvain), Weijia Wang (Shandong University), Xiao Wang (Northwestern University)
paper.summary_zh: 随着乱码电路和安全计算在智能手机、IoT和专用硬件等侧信道敏感环境中变得可行，内部秘密可能遭受泄漏攻击。论文研究泄漏弹性乱码（leakage-resilient garbling），在经典隐私、茫然性和真实性概念中加入对乱码函数泄漏的建模，并定义相应的泄漏弹性变体。作者分析流行乱码方案，揭示线标签重用和异或泄漏带来的额外侧信道弱点。随后在Gueron等人的GLNP方案中引入标签刷新，提出GLNPLR并证明其满足泄漏弹性定义。性能比较显示，在2Gbps带宽下乱码AES电路时，GLNPLR比使用二阶侧信道掩码的HalfGates快60倍（AES-NI）或5倍（无AES-NI）。

paper.title: Bytes to Schlep? Use a FEP: Hiding Protocol Metadata with Fully Encrypted Protocols
paper.description: Fully Encrypted Protocols (FEPs) have arisen in practice as a technique to avoid network censorship. Such protocols are designed to produce messages that appear completely random. This design hides communications metadata, such as version and length fields, and makes it difficult to even determine what protocol is being used. Moreover, these protocols frequently support padding to hide the length of protocol fields and the contained message. These techniques have relevance well beyond censorship circumvention, as protecting protocol metadata has security and privacy benefits for all Internet communications. The security of FEP designs depends on cryptographic assumptions, but neither security definitions nor proofs exist for them. We provide novel security definitions that capture the metadata-protection goals of FEPs. Our definitions are given in both the datastream and datagram settings, which model the ubiquitous TCP and UDP interfaces available to protocol designers. We prove relations among these new notions and existing security definitions. We further present new FEP constructions and prove their security. Finally, we survey existing FEP candidates and characterize the extent to which they satisfy FEP security. We identify novel ways in which these protocols are identifiable, including their responses to the introduction of data errors and the sizes of their smallest protocol messages.
paper.author: Ellis Fenske (U.S. Naval Academy), Aaron Johnson (U.S. Naval Research Laboratory)
paper.summary_zh: 完全加密协议（FEP）被用于规避网络审查，其设计目标是让消息看起来完全随机，从而隐藏协议版本、长度等通信元数据。论文指出尽管FEP已在实践中使用，但缺乏形式化安全定义和证明，且其元数据保护目标尚未被精确刻画。作者分别在数据流和数据报设置下提出新的安全定义，并证明这些概念与已有安全定义之间的关系。论文进一步给出新的FEP构造并证明安全性，同时调查现有FEP候选协议，发现它们在响应数据错误、最小协议消息大小等方面仍可被识别。该工作为FEP的设计、分析和部署提供了理论基础与改进方向。

paper.title: A Framework for Differential Privacy Against Timing Attacks
paper.description: The standard definition of differential privacy (DP) ensures that a mechanism's output distribution on adjacent datasets is indistinguishable. However, real-world implementations of DP can, and often do, reveal information through their runtime distributions, making them susceptible to timing attacks.
paper.author: Zachary Ratliff (Harvard University), Salil Vadhan (Harvard University)
paper.summary_zh: 差分隐私（DP）的标准定义保证相邻数据集上机制输出分布不可区分，但实际实现可能通过运行时间分布泄露信息，从而遭受时间攻击。论文提出一个针对时间攻击的差分隐私框架。该框架将运行时间侧信道纳入DP的隐私分析，定义和构造对时间攻击具有鲁棒性的机制。作者旨在弥合形式化DP保证与实际实现中时间泄露之间的差距。摘要未给出具体实验细节，但该工作为设计抗时间侧信道的差分隐私系统提供了理论基础。

paper.title: Camel: Communication-Efficient and Maliciously Secure Federated Learning in the Shuffle Model of Differential Privacy
paper.description: Federated learning (FL) has rapidly become a compelling paradigm that enables multiple clients to jointly train a model by sharing only gradient updates for aggregation, without revealing their local private data. In order to protect the gradient updates which could also be privacy-sensitive, there has been a line of work studying local differential privacy (LDP) mechanisms to provide a formal privacy guarantee. With LDP mechanisms, clients locally perturb their gradient updates before sharing them out for aggregation. However, such approaches are known for greatly degrading the model utility, due to heavy noise addition. To enable a better privacy-utility trade-off, a recently emerging trend is to apply the shuffle model of DP in FL, which relies on an intermediate shuffling operation on the perturbed gradient updates to achieve privacy amplification. Following this trend, in this paper, we present Camel, a new communication-efficient and maliciously secure FL framework in the shuffle model of DP. Camel first departs from existing works by ambitiously supporting integrity check for the shuffle computation, achieving security against malicious adversary. Specifically, Camel builds on the trending cryptographic primitive of secret-shared shuffle, with custom techniques we develop for optimizing system-wide communication efficiency, and for lightweight integrity checks to harden the security of server-side computation. In addition, we also derive a significantly tighter bound on the privacy loss through analyzing the Rényi differential privacy (RDP) of the overall FL process. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Camel achieves better privacy-utility trade-offs than the state-of-the-art work, with promising performance.
paper.author: Shuangqing Xu (Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen), Yifeng Zheng (Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen), Zhongyun Hua (Harbin Institute of Technology, Shenzhen)
paper.summary_zh: 联邦学习允许客户端仅共享梯度更新来联合训练模型，但梯度仍可能泄露隐私；本地差分隐私（LDP）虽提供形式化保证，却因噪声过大会严重损害模型效用。论文提出Camel，在差分隐私混洗模型中实现通信高效且可抵抗恶意敌手的联邦学习框架。Camel基于秘密共享混洗，并设计自定义技术优化全局通信效率，同时加入轻量级完整性检查以硬化服务器端计算安全。作者还通过Rényi差分隐私分析得到更紧的隐私损失界。实验表明Camel在隐私-效用权衡上优于现有工作。

paper.title: A Unified Membership Inference Method for Visual Self-supervised Encoder via Part-aware Capability
paper.description: Self-supervised learning shows promise in harnessing extensive unlabeled data, but it also confronts significant privacy concerns, especially in vision. In this paper, we aim to perform membership inference on visual self-supervised models in a more realistic setting: self-supervised training method and details are unknown for an adversary when attacking as he usually faces a black-box system in practice. In this setting, considering that self-supervised model could be trained by completely different self-supervised paradigms, e.g., masked image modeling and contrastive learning, with complex training details, we propose a unified membership inference method called PartCrop. It is motivated by the shared part-aware capability among models and stronger part response on the training data. Specifically, PartCrop crops parts of objects in an image to query responses with the image in representation space. We conduct extensive attacks on self-supervised models with different training protocols and structures using three widely used image datasets. The results verify the effectiveness and generalization of PartCrop. Moreover, to defend against PartCrop, we evaluate two common approaches, i.e., early stop and differential privacy, and propose a tailored method called shrinking crop scale range. The defense experiments indicate that all of them are effective. Our code is available at https://github.com/JiePKU/PartCrop.
paper.author: Jie Zhu (Peking University), Jirong Zha (Tsinghua-Berkeley Shenzhen Institute, Tsinghua University), Ding Li (Peking University), Leye Wang (Peking University)
paper.summary_zh: 自监督学习能利用大量无标签数据，但也引发隐私担忧，尤其是视觉自监督模型的成员推断问题。论文考虑更现实的黑盒场景：攻击者不知道自监督训练方法和细节。作者提出统一成员推断方法PartCrop，利用不同自监督模型共享的部分感知能力以及训练数据上更强的部分响应。PartCrop通过裁剪图像中的物体部分并在表示空间中查询响应来实施攻击。在三种图像数据集和不同训练协议、结构的自监督模型上，实验验证了其有效性和泛化性；论文还评估了早停、差分隐私及定制的缩小裁剪尺度范围等防御方法，均显示一定效果。

paper.title: Understanding Implosion in Text-to-Image Generative Models
paper.description: Recent works show that text-to-image generative models are surprisingly vulnerable to a variety of poisoning attacks. Empirical results find that these models can be corrupted by altering associations between individual text prompts and associated visual features. Furthermore, a number of concurrent poisoning attacks can induce "model implosion," where the model becomes unable to produce meaningful images for unpoisoned prompts. These intriguing findings highlight the absence of an intuitive framework to understand poisoning attacks on these models. In this work, we establish the first analytical framework on robustness of image generative models to poisoning attacks, by modeling and analyzing the behavior of the cross-attention mechanism in latent diffusion models. We model cross-attention training as an abstract problem of "supervised graph alignment" and formally quantify the impact of training data by the hardness of alignment, measured by an Alignment Difficulty (AD) metric. The higher the AD, the harder the alignment. We prove that AD increases with the number of individual prompts (or concepts) poisoned. As AD grows, the alignment task becomes increasingly difficult, yielding highly distorted outcomes that frequently map meaningful text prompts to undefined or meaningless visual representations. As a result, the generative model implodes and outputs random, incoherent images at large. We validate our analytical framework through extensive experiments, and we confirm and explain the unexpected (and unexplained) effect of model implosion while producing new, unforeseen insights. Our work provides a useful tool for studying poisoning attacks against diffusion models and their defenses.
paper.author: Wenxin Ding (University of Chicago), Cathy Yuanchen Li (University of Chicago), Shawn Shan (University of Chicago), Ben Y. Zhao (University of Chicago), Haitao Zheng (University of Chicago)
paper.summary_zh: 近期研究表明文本到图像生成模型易受多种投毒攻击，改变文本提示与视觉特征的关联，多个并发投毒甚至可导致“模型内爆”，使模型对未投毒提示也无法生成有意义图像。论文建立首个分析图像生成模型抗投毒鲁棒性的理论框架，通过建模潜在扩散模型中的交叉注意力机制。作者将交叉注意力训练抽象为“监督图对齐”问题，并用对齐难度（AD）度量训练数据的影响，证明AD随被投毒提示或概念数量增加而增大。当AD增大时，对齐任务越来越困难，导致有意义文本提示被映射到无定义或无意义视觉表示，模型输出随机不连贯图像。大量实验验证了该分析框架，并解释了模型内爆现象，为研究扩散模型投毒攻击与防御提供了工具。

paper.title: Eclipse: Preventing Speculative Memory-error Abuse with Artificial Data Dependencies
paper.description: Historically, researchers have treated memory safety-based and speculative execution attacks as two separate domains. Recent work has introduced Speculative Memory-error Abuse (SMA) attacks, which combine memory corruption vulnerabilities with Spectre-like primitives. Using SMA, an attacker can leak sensitive program information and defeat a wide variety of memory-corruption mitigations, including (K)ASLR, software-based XOM, and even ARM PA, eventually carrying out an end-to-end (architecturally-visible) exploit. We present Eclipse: a novel protection scheme against SMA attacks. Eclipse works by propagating artificial data dependencies onto sensitive data, preventing the CPU from using attacker-controlled data during speculative execution. We demonstrate that Eclipse provides comprehensive protection against speculative-probing and Pacman-style attacks, two prominent examples of Speculative Memory-error Abuse attacks that target both the x86(-64) and ARM architectures. We evaluate the performance of Eclipse on x86-64 and demonstrate that it introduces minimal overhead, compared to alternative hardening approaches, incurring ≈0%--9.5% slowdown on SPEC CPU 2017, up to 8.6% slowdown in real-world applications, and negligible overhead in the Linux kernel.
paper.author: Neophytos Christou (Brown University), Alexander J. Gaidis (Brown University), Vaggelis Atlidakis (Brown University), Vasileios P. Kemerlis (Brown University)
paper.summary_zh: 近期研究揭示了推测性内存错误滥用（SMA）攻击，将内存破坏漏洞与Spectre类推测执行原语结合，可泄露敏感信息并绕过(K)ASLR、XOM乃至ARM PA等缓解措施。论文提出Eclipse，一种针对SMA攻击的新型防护方案。Eclipse通过向敏感数据传播人工数据依赖，阻止CPU在推测执行期间使用攻击者控制的数据。作者证明Eclipse能全面防御speculative-probing和Pacman风格攻击，覆盖x86(-64)与ARM架构。性能评估显示其在x86-64上开销极低，SPEC CPU 2017 slowdown约0%–9.5%，真实应用最高8.6%，Linux内核中开销可忽略。

paper.title: Specification and Verification of Strong Timing Isolation of Hardware Enclaves
paper.description: The process isolation enforceable by commodity hardware and operating systems is too weak to protect secrets from malicious code running on the same machine: attacks exploit timing side channels derived from contention on shared microarchitectural resources to extract secrets. With appropriate hardware support, however, we can construct isolated enclaves and safeguard independent processes from interference through timing side channels, a step towards confidentiality and integrity guarantees.
paper.author: Stella Lau (MIT CSAIL), Thomas Bourgeat (EPFL), Clément Pit-Claudel (EPFL), Adam Chlipala (MIT CSAIL)
paper.summary_zh: 商品硬件和操作系统的进程隔离不足以保护秘密，攻击者可利用共享微架构资源竞争产生的时间侧信道提取信息。论文研究如何通过硬件支持构造隔离飞地，并形式化规定和验证强时间隔离。作者提出强时间隔离的规范，并构建验证方法以证明硬件飞地不会因时间侧信道干扰而泄露信息。该工作为硬件隔离机制提供更强的机密性和完整性保证，推动可验证的安全飞地设计。

paper.title: Selling Satisfaction: A Qualitative Analysis of Cybersecurity Awareness Vendors’ Promises
paper.description: Security awareness and training (SAT) vendors operate in a growing multi-billion dollar market. They publish various marketing promises on their websites to their customers -- organizations of all sizes. This paper investigates how these promises align with customers' needs, how they relate to human-centered security challenges highlighted in prior research, and what narrative is presented regarding the role of employees (as SAT recipients). We also investigate the level of transparency in vendor promises, as to whether it constitutes an information asymmetry. We gathered search terms from n=30 awareness professionals to perform an automated Google search and scraping of SAT vendors' websites. We then performed a thematic analysis of 2,476 statements on 156 websites from 59 vendors.
