Finally, we introduce a method for auditing attribute inference privacy, improving the empirical estimation of worst-case privacy through crafting adversarial canary records.
paper.author: Zhuohang Li (Vanderbilt University), Andrew Lowy (University of Wisconsin-Madison), Jing Liu (Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories), Toshiaki Koike-Akino (Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories), Kieran Parsons (Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories), Brad Malin (Vanderbilt University), Ye Wang (Mitsubishi Electric Research Laboratories)
paper.summary_zh: 在分布式学习中，模型迭代更新会共享由敏感用户数据计算出的梯度，已有研究虽揭示多种隐私风险，但缺乏对梯度信息泄露的系统性分析。本文提出了一个统一的博弈论框架，将属性推断、性质推断、分布推断和用户披露等攻击纳入同一分析视角，并在五种数据集和多种数据模态上考察了对手不确定性对推断能力的影响。实验表明，仅依赖数据聚合不足以抵御梯度推断攻击；作者进一步评估了梯度剪枝、符号梯度下降、对抗扰动、变分信息瓶颈和差分隐私等五类防御在静态与自适应对手下的效果，并从信息论角度解释其有效性。最后，文章提出通过构造对抗性金丝雀记录来审计属性推断隐私，改进最坏情况隐私的经验估计。

paper.title: Membership Inference Attacks Against In-Context Learning
paper.description: Adapting Large Language Models (LLMs) to specific tasks introduces concerns about computational efficiency, prompting an exploration of efficient methods such as In-Context Learning (ICL). However, the vulnerability of ICL to privacy attacks under realistic assumptions remains largely unexplored. In this work, we present the first membership inference attack tailored for ICL, relying solely on generated texts without their associated probabilities. We propose four attack strategies tailored to various constrained scenarios and conduct extensive experiments on four popular large language models. Empirical results show that our attacks can accurately determine membership status in most cases, e.g., 95% accuracy advantage against LLaMA, indicating that the associated risks are much higher than those shown by existing probability-based attacks. Additionally, we propose a hybrid attack that synthesizes the strengths of the aforementioned strategies, achieving an accuracy advantage of over 95% in most cases. Furthermore, we investigate three potential defenses targeting data, instruction, and output. Results demonstrate combining defenses from orthogonal dimensions significantly reduces privacy leakage and offers enhanced privacy assurances.
paper.author: Rui Wen (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security), Zheng Li (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security), Michael Backes (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security), Yang Zhang (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security)
paper.summary_zh: 大语言模型通过上下文学习（ICL）适配下游任务时虽避免参数更新，但其在现实假设下的成员推断隐私风险尚未被充分研究。本文提出首个面向 ICL 的成员推断攻击，仅依赖模型生成的文本而不需要访问输出概率，并针对受限场景设计了四种攻击策略。作者在四个流行大语言模型上开展实验，发现攻击在多数情况下能准确判断样本是否为上下文成员，例如对 LLaMA 达到95%的准确率优势，显著高于现有基于概率的攻击。文章还提出融合多种策略的混合攻击，在多数情况下准确率优势超过95%。最后评估了面向数据、指令和输出的三类防御，表明组合正交维度的防御可显著降低隐私泄露。

paper.title: Trident of Poseidon: A Generalized Approach for Detecting Deepfake Voices
paper.description: Deepfakes, an increasingly prevalent form of information attack, pose serious threats to security and privacy. Deepfake voice attacks, in particular, have the potential to cause widespread disruption, creating an urgent need for an effective detection system. In this research, we propose the Trident of Poseidon - a novel set of triad training strategies aimed at enhancing the generalizability of deepfake voice detection models. Our solution comprises three key components: (1) Supervised Contrastive Learning, (2) Hard Negative Mining by Audio Re-synthesizing, and (3) Effective Proactive Batch Sampling. Together, these enable the model to learn more robust features. Our extensive experiments demonstrate that our approach outperforms existing methods in both in-domain and out-of-domain testing scenarios, making significant strides toward securing digital media against deepfake voice attacks.
paper.author: Thien-Phuc Doan (Soongsil University), Hung Dinh-Xuan (Soongsil University), Taewon Ryu (Soongsil University), Inho Kim (Soongsil University), Woongjae Lee (Soongsil University), Kihun Hong (Soongsil University), Souhwan Jung (Soongsil University)
paper.summary_zh: 深度伪造语音攻击日益普遍，对安全与隐私构成严重威胁，亟需具备强泛化能力的检测系统。本文提出 Trident of Poseidon，一套由三项训练策略组成的三叉戟方法，旨在提升深度伪造语音检测模型的泛化性。具体包括监督对比学习、基于音频重合成难负样本挖掘以及有效的主动批量采样，使模型学习更鲁棒的特征表示。大量实验表明，该方法在域内和域外测试场景中均优于现有方法，为抵御深度伪造语音攻击、保护数字媒体安全迈出重要一步。

paper.title: Blind and Low-Vision Individuals’ Detection of Audio Deepfakes
paper.description: Audio deepfakes are a form of deception where convincing speech sentences are synthesized through machine learning means to give an impression of a human speaker. Audio deepfakes emerge as an attractive vector for targeting users that rely on audio accessibility, such as individuals who are blind or low vision. The critical reliance on speech both as a medium and an affordance puts this population at an undue risk of being deceived as they rely solely on themselves to detect whether a piece of audio is a deepfake or not. To better understand the nature of this risk considering the nuanced reliance on assistive technologies such as screen readers, we conducted a user study with n=16 blind and low vision individuals from the US. Our participants achieved an overall discernment accuracy of 59%, and clips identified as deep fakes were only actually deepfakes in 50.8% of the cases (precision). The participants that self-identified as "low vision" performed slightly better (accuracy of 61%, precision of 64%) compared to the ones that self-identified as "blind" (accuracy of 55%, precision of 56%). Our qualitative results show that the participants in the "blind" group mostly considered a combination of infliction, imperfections in the voice, and the intensity in the speech delivery as discernment factors. The participants in the "low vision" group mostly used the speaker's pitch, enunciation, emotion, and the fluency and articulation of the speaker as discernment cues. Overall, participants felt that audio deepfakes have the potential to deceive visually impaired individuals with political disinformation, impersonate their voice in authentication and smart homes, and specifically target them with voice phishing and enhanced scams.
paper.author: Filipo Sharevski (DePaul University), Aziz Zeidieh (University of Illinois Urbana-Champaign), Jennifer Vander Loop (DePaul University), Peter Jachim (DePaul University)
paper.summary_zh: 音频深度伪造可通过合成逼真语音实施欺骗，而依赖语音作为主要信息渠道的盲人和低视力人群可能面临更高风险。本文对美国16名盲人或低视力用户开展了用户研究，考察他们识别音频深度伪造的能力与判断依据。参与者总体辨别准确率为59%，被判定为深度伪造的片段中实际为深度伪造的比例仅为50.8%；自认为低视力者的表现略好于自认为盲人者。定性结果显示，盲人组更关注语音中的造作感、瑕疵和表达强度，低视力组更依赖音高、发音、情感和流畅度等线索。参与者还担心音频深度伪造会被用于政治虚假信息、语音身份冒充、智能家居攻击以及语音钓鱼和诈骗。

paper.title: OctopusTaint: Advanced Data Flow Analysis for Detecting Taint-Based Vulnerabilities in IoT/IIoT Firmware
paper.description: The widespread integration of Internet of Things (IoT) and Industrial IoT (IIoT) devices in respectively home and business environments offers both benefits and perils. While these devices, such as IP cameras and network routers improve operational efficiency with their user-friendly web interfaces, they also broaden the potential for cybersecurity vulnerabilities. Recent studies highlight the vulnerability of these devices to taint-based attacks, demonstrating that even attackers with limited permissions can gain control of a device. Current state-of-the-art solutions for mitigating these risks primarily utilize Dynamic Symbolic Execution (DSE). Although effective, DSE is computationally costly and challenging for large-scale analysis. Besides, during inspection, these approaches typically exhibit over-taint behavior by producing a large number of alerts, many of which are false positives due to ineffective handling of sanitization measures that might be in place. To overcome these limitations, we introduce OctopusTaint, an innovative static-based taint analysis approach that integrates advanced data flow analysis with backtracking techniques. OctopusTaint is distinguished by its integration of a sanitization inspection module and sophisticated post-processing filters. These features are specifically designed to minimize false positives effectively while ensuring the accurate identification of genuine security threats. OctopusTaint also excels in tracking transformed tainted inputs across NVRAM, identifying new user-defined taint source functions while addressing the challenges associated with indirect calls and aliasing. Through comparative performance evaluations, OctopusTaint demonstrates superior performance over the current state-of-the-art solutions, SaTC, EmTaint, and MangoDFA. It reports genuine extra tainted sinks in considerable less time (24% faster). Furthermore, OctopusTaint identifies 82% of tainted sinks within EmTaint 's labeled dataset while exhibiting its advanced capability in sanitization inspection. It correctly flags as sanitized 320 sinks, which were misidentified as genuine alerts by EmTaint. Furthermore, OctopusTaint uncovers additional candidates overlooked by EmTaint, leveraging its enhanced detection mechanisms for new taint sources. OctopusTaint successfully identifies 142 n -day vulnerabilities previously reported by SaTC and EmTaint, in addition to discovering dozens of potential 0-day candidates.
paper.author: Abdullah Qasem (Security Research Centre, Concordia University, Montreal, QC, Canada), Mourad Debbabi (Security Research Centre, Concordia University, Quebec, Canada), Andrei Soeanu (Security Research Centre, Concordia University, Montreal, QC, Canada)
paper.summary_zh: IoT/IIoT 设备通过 Web 接口暴露大量攻击面，污点类漏洞可使权限有限的攻击者控制设备；现有基于动态符号执行的检测方法计算开销大且容易因净化处理误判产生大量误报。本文提出 OctopusTaint，一种基于静态分析的污点检测方法，结合高级数据流分析与回溯技术，并引入净化检查模块和后处理过滤器以降低误报。该方法还能跟踪经过 NVRAM 转换的污点输入、识别新的用户自定义污点源函数，并处理间接调用和别名问题。与 SaTC、EmTaint 和 MangoDFA 等最先进方案相比，OctopusTaint 报告额外污点汇聚点且速度提升24%，在 EmTaint 标注数据集中识别出82%的污点汇聚点，并将320个实际已净化的汇聚点正确标记为安全。它复现了 SaTC 和 EmTaint 报告的142个 n-day 漏洞，还发现数十个潜在0-day候选。

paper.title: Top of the Heap: Efficient Memory Error Protection of Safe Heap Objects
paper.description: Heap memory errors remain a major source of software vulnerabilities. Existing memory safety defenses aim at protecting all objects, resulting in high performance cost and incomplete protection. Instead, we propose an approach that accurately identifies objects that are inexpensive to protect, and design a method to protect such objects comprehensively from all classes of memory errors. Towards this goal, we introduce the Uriah system that (1) statically identifies the heap objects whose accesses satisfy spatial and type safety, and (2) dynamically allocates such "safe" heap objects on an isolated safe heap to enforce a form of temporal safety while preserving spatial and type safety, called temporal allocated-type safety. Uriah finds 72.0% of heap allocation sites produce objects whose accesses always satisfy spatial and type safety in the SPEC CPU2006/2017 benchmarks, 5 server programs, and Firefox, which are then isolated on a safe heap using Uriah allocator to enforce temporal allocated-type safety. Uriah incurs only 2.9% and 2.6% runtime overhead, along with 9.3% and 5.4% memory overhead, on the SPEC CPU 2006 and 2017 benchmarks, while preventing exploits on all the heap memory errors in DARPA CGC binaries and 28 recent CVEs. Additionally, using existing defenses to enforce their memory safety guarantees on the unsafe heap objects significantly reduces overhead, enabling the protection of heap objects from all classes of memory errors at more practical costs.
paper.author: Kaiming Huang (The Pennsylvania State University), Mathias Payer (EPFL), Zhiyun Qian (UC Riverside), Jack Sampson (The Pennsylvania State University), Gang Tan (The Pennsylvania State University), Trent Jaeger (UC Riverside)
paper.summary_zh: 堆内存错误是软件漏洞的主要来源之一，但现有内存安全防御通常试图保护所有对象，导致性能开销高且保护不完整。本文提出 Uriah 系统，先静态识别访问始终满足空间安全与类型安全的堆对象，再将其动态分配到隔离的安全堆上，以“时间分配类型安全”的形式强制时间安全，同时保持空间和类型安全。在 SPEC CPU2006/2017、5个服务器程序和 Firefox 中，72%的堆分配点产生的对象可被判定为安全对象并放入安全堆。Uriah 在 SPEC CPU2006/2017 上仅带来2.9%和2.6%的运行时开销以及9.3%和5.4%的内存开销，同时阻止了 DARPA CGC 二进制和28个近期 CVE 中的所有堆内存错误利用。对不安全堆对象使用现有防御还可进一步降低开销，使全类别堆内存错误保护更具实际可行性。

paper.title: State Machine Mutation-based Testing Framework for Wireless Communication Protocols
paper.description: This paper proposes Proteus, a protocol state machine, property-guided, and budget-aware automated testing approach for discovering logical vulnerabilities in wireless protocol implementations. Proteus maintains its budget awareness by generating test cases (i.e., each being a sequence of protocol messages) that are not only meaningful (i.e., the test case mostly follows the desirable protocol flow except for some controlled deviations) but also have a high probability of violating the desirable properties. To demonstrate its effectiveness, we evaluated Proteus in two different protocol implementations, namely 4G LTE and BLE, across 23 consumer devices (11 for 4G LTE and 12 for BLE). Proteus discovered 25 unique issues, including 112 instances. Affected vendors have positively acknowledged 14 vulnerabilities through 5 CVEs.
paper.author: Syed Md Mukit Rashid (The Pennsylvania State University), Tianwei Wu (The Pennsylvania State University), Kai Tu (Pennsylvania State University), Abdullah Al Ishtiaq (Pennsylvania State University), Ridwanul Hasan Tanvir (Pennsylvania State University), Yilu Dong (The Pennsylvania State University), Omar Chowdhury (Stony Brook University), Syed Rafiul Hussain (Pennsylvania State University)
paper.summary_zh: 无线通信协议实现中的逻辑漏洞可能导致严重安全后果，但自动化发现此类漏洞仍具挑战。本文提出 Proteus，一种基于协议状态机、属性引导且预算感知的自动化测试框架，用于发现无线协议实现中的逻辑漏洞。Proteus 通过生成既大体遵循正常协议流程、又包含受控偏差并具有较高属性违反概率的协议消息序列作为测试用例，从而在有限预算下高效探索。作者在4G LTE和BLE两类协议实现、23款消费设备（11款4G LTE、12款BLE）上评估 Proteus，共发现25类独特问题、112个实例。受影响厂商已确认14个漏洞并获得5个CVE编号。

paper.title: Spec-o-Scope: Cache Probing at Cache Speed
paper.description: Over the last two decades, microarchitectural side channels have been the focus of a large body of research on the development of new attack techniques, exploiting them to attack various classes of targets and designing mitigations. One line of work focuses on increasing the speed of the attacks, achieving higher levels of temporal resolution that can allow attackers to learn finer-grained information. The most recent addition to this line of work is Prime+Scope [CCS '21], which only requires a single access to the L1 cache to confirm the absence of victim activity in a cache set. While significantly faster than prior attacks, Prime+Scope is still an order of magnitude slower than cache access. In this work, we set out to close this gap.
paper.author: Gal Horowitz (Tel Aviv University), Eyal Ronen (Tel Aviv University), Yuval Yarom (Ruhr University Bochum)
paper.summary_zh: 微架构侧信道研究长期追求更高时间分辨率，以便攻击者获取更细粒度信息；Prime+Scope（CCS '21）虽只需一次 L1 缓存访问即可确认缓存组中无受害者活动，但仍比缓存访问慢一个数量级。本文提出 Spec-o-Scope，旨在将缓存探测速度推进到接近缓存访问速度，从而缩小这一差距。作者围绕更高速度的缓存探测原语展开设计，并展示了该技术如何提升侧信道攻击的时间分辨率。该工作对评估和缓解微架构侧信道风险具有重要意义。

paper.title: Secure Parallel Computation with Oblivious State Transitions
paper.description: We introduce Oblivious Parallel Stateful Computation (OPSC), a form of secure multi-party computation (MPC) tailored for stateful machine computation models emphasizing parallel execution across multiple data. OPSC enables parties to compute multiple results simultaneously in a parallel fashion, leveraging all data from current states and auxiliary inputs dynamically entered at that point. With its parallel and dynamic nature, OPSC holds promise for privacy-preserving applications in intricate decision-making scenarios involving multiple agents, such as traffic analyses, individual consumer behavior economics, and epidemiological simulations.
paper.author: Nuttapong Attrapadung (AIST), Kota Isayama (SMBC Nikko Securities Inc.), Kunihiko Sadakane (The University of Tokyo), Kazunari Tozawa (The University of Tokyo)
paper.summary_zh: 针对有状态机器计算在多个数据上并行执行时的安全多方计算需求，本文提出了 Oblivious Parallel Stateful Computation（OPSC）模型。OPSC 允许各参与方并行地同时计算多个结果，并动态利用当前状态和当时输入的辅助数据。该模型面向涉及多智能体的复杂隐私保护决策场景，如交通分析、个体消费行为经济学和流行病模拟。摘要主要给出模型定位与潜在应用，未报告具体实验评估。

paper.title: Sparrow : Space-Efficient zkSNARK for Data-Parallel Circuits and Applications to Zero-Knowledge Decision Trees
paper.description: Space-efficient SNARKs aim to reduce the prover's space overhead which is one the main obstacles for deploying SNARKs in practice, as it can be prohibitively large (e.g., orders of magnitude larger than natively performing the computation). In this work, we propose Sparrow, a novel space-efficient zero-knowledge SNARK for data-parallel arithmetic circuits with two attractive features: (i) it is the first space-efficient scheme where, for a given field, the prover overhead increases with a multiplicative sublogarithmic factor as the circuit size increases, and (ii) compared to prior space-efficient SNARKs that work for arbitrary arithmetic circuits, it achieves prover space asymptotically smaller than the circuit size itself. Our key building block is a novel space-efficient sumcheck argument with improved prover time which may be of independent interest. Our experimental results for three use cases (arbitrary data parallel circuits, multiplication trees, batch SHA256 hashing) indicate Sparrow outperforms the prior state-of-the-art space-efficient SNARK for arithmetic circuits Gemini (Bootle et al., EUROCRYPT'22) by 3.2-28.7x in total prover space and 3.1-11.3x in prover time. We then use Sparrow to build zero-knowledge proofs of tree training and prediction, relying on its space efficiency to scale to large datasets and forests of multiple trees. Compared to a (non-space-efficient) optimal-time SNARK based on the GKR protocol, we observe prover space reduction of 16-240x for tree training while maintaining essentially the same prover and verifier times and proof size. Even more interestingly, our prover requires comparable space to natively perform the underlying computation. E.g., for a 400MB dataset, our prover only needs 1.4x more space than the native computation.
paper.author: Christodoulos Pappas (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology), Dimitrios Papadopoulos (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology)
paper.summary_zh: 针对 SNARK 证明者空间开销过大、阻碍实际部署的问题，本文提出面向数据并行算术电路的空间高效零知识 SNARK——Sparrow。其核心是一种新型空间高效 sumcheck 论证，并改进了证明者时间；对于给定有限域，证明者开销随电路规模呈乘性子对数增长，且空间渐近小于电路本身。在任意数据并行电路、乘法树和批量 SHA256 哈希等用例上，Sparrow 比 Gemini 节省 3.2–28.7 倍总证明者空间和 3.1–11.3 倍证明者时间。将其用于树训练与预测的零知识证明时，相比基于 GKR 的非空间高效最优时间方案，证明者空间减少 16–240 倍，且证明者和验证者时间与证明大小基本不变；对 400MB 数据集，证明者仅需原生计算约 1.4 倍空间。

paper.title: ThorPIR: Single Server PIR via Homomorphic Thorp Shuffles
paper.description: Private Information Retrieval (PIR) is a two player protocol where the client, given some query x ε [N], interacts with the server, which holds a N-bit string DB, in order to privately retrieve DB[x]. In this work, we focus on the single-server client-preprocessing model, initially proposed by Corrigan-Gibbs and Kogan (EUROCRYPT 2020), where the client and server first run a joint preprocessing algorithm, after which the client can retrieve elements from DB privately in time sublinear in N. Most known constructions of single-server client-preprocessing PIR follow one of two paradigms: They feature either (1) a linear-bandwidth offline phase where the client downloads the whole database from the server, or (2) a sublinear-bandwidth offline phase where however the server has to compute a large-depth (Ωλ(N)) circuit under fully-homomorphic encryption (FHE) in order to execute the preprocessing phase.
paper.author: Ben Fisch (Yale University), Arthur Lazzaretti (Yale University), Zeyu Liu (Yale University), Charalampos Papamanthou (Yale University)
paper.summary_zh: 私密信息检索（PIR）允许客户端在不暴露查询的前提下从服务器数据库取回目标元素；本文关注单服务器客户端预处理模型，即客户端与服务器先联合预处理，之后客户端能以亚线性时间私密检索。现有单服务器客户端预处理 PIR 主要分两类：离线阶段线性带宽，即客户端下载整个数据库；或离线阶段亚线性带宽，但服务器需在全同态加密下计算大深度电路。本文提出 ThorPIR，基于同态 Thorp 混洗构造单服务器 PIR，旨在避免上述两类方案的高带宽或高计算开销。摘要未给出具体实验结果，但将该方案定位为改进单服务器 PIR 离线预处理效率与安全性。

paper.title: Is Difficulty Calibration All We Need? Towards More Practical Membership Inference Attacks
paper.description: The vulnerability of machine learning models to Membership Inference Attacks (MIAs) has garnered considerable attention in recent years. These attacks determine whether a data sample belongs to the model's training set or not. Recent research has focused on reference-based attacks, which leverage difficulty calibration with independently trained reference models. While empirical studies have demonstrated its effectiveness, there is a notable gap in our understanding of the circumstances under which it succeeds or fails. In this paper, we take a further step towards a deeper understanding of the role of difficulty calibration. Our observations reveal inherent limitations in calibration methods, leading to the misclassification of non-members and suboptimal performance, particularly on high-loss samples. We further identify that these errors stem from an imperfect sampling of the potential distribution and a strong dependence of membership scores on the model parameters. By shedding light on these issues, we propose RAPID: a query-efficient and computation-efficient MIA that directly Re-leverAges the original membershiP scores to mItigate the errors in Difficulty calibration. Our experimental results, spanning 9 datasets and 5 model architectures, demonstrate that RAPID outperforms previous state-of-the-art attacks (e.g., LiRA and Canary offline) across different metrics while remaining computationally efficient. Our observations and analysis challenge the current de facto paradigm of difficulty calibration in high-precision inference, encouraging greater attention to the persistent risks posed by MIAs in more practical scenarios.
paper.author: Yu He (Wuhan University), Boheng Li (Wuhan University), Yao Wang (Wuhan University), Mengda Yang (Wuhan University), Juan Wang (Wuhan University), Hongxin Hu (University at Buffalo), Xingyu Zhao (University of Warwick)
paper.summary_zh: 针对成员推断攻击中基于参考模型的难度校准方法缺乏充分理解的问题，本文深入分析其成功与失败条件。作者发现难度校准存在固有局限，会导致非成员被误分类，并在高损失样本上性能次优；根源在于潜在分布采样不完美以及成员分数强烈依赖模型参数。为此提出 RAPID，直接重新利用原始成员分数来缓解难度校准误差，兼具查询高效和计算高效。在 9 个数据集和 5 种模型架构上，RAPID 在多项指标上优于 LiRA 和 Canary offline 等先进攻击。该工作挑战了高精度成员推断中难度校准的主流范式。

paper.title: HyperTheft: Thieving Model Weights from TEE-Shielded Neural Networks via Ciphertext Side Channels
paper.description: Trusted execution environments (TEEs) are widely employed to protect deep neural networks (DNNs) from untrusted hosts (e.g., hypervisors). By shielding DNNs as fully black-box via encryption, TEEs mitigate model weight leakage and its follow-up white-box attacks. However, this paper uncovers that the confidentiality of TEE-shielded DNNs can be violated due to an emerging threat towards TEEs: ciphertext side channels of TEEs create weight-dependent observations during a DNN's execution. Despite the potential of inferring DNN weights from ciphertext side channels, existing techniques are inapplicable due to their over-strong requirements and the high precision required by DNN weights. A DNN can have millions of weight elements, and even a few incorrectly recovered weight elements may make the DNN non-functional.
paper.author: Yuanyuan Yuan (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology), Zhibo Liu (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology), Sen Deng (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology), Yanzuo Chen (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology), Shuai Wang (The Hong Kong University of Science and Technology), Yinqian Zhang (SUSTech), Zhendong Su (ETH Zurich)
paper.summary_zh: 可信执行环境（TEE）常被用于将深度神经网络（DNN）加密为黑盒，以保护模型权重免受不可信宿主机攻击。本文发现 TEE 的密文侧信道会在 DNN 执行过程中产生依赖权重的观测，从而破坏 TEE 屏蔽 DNN 的机密性。由于 DNN 可能包含数百万个权重元素，且权重恢复对精度要求极高，现有侧信道推断技术难以直接适用，少量错误恢复即可使模型失效。论文提出 HyperTheft，利用密文侧信道从 TEE 屏蔽的神经网络中窃取模型权重，凸显了该新型威胁的严重性。

paper.title: Legilimens: Practical and Unified Content Moderation for Large Language Model Services
paper.description: Given the societal impact of unsafe content generated by large language models (LLMs), ensuring that LLM services comply with safety standards is a crucial concern for LLM service providers. Common content moderation methods are limited by an effectiveness-and-efficiency dilemma, where simple models are fragile while sophisticated models consume excessive computational resources. In this paper, we reveal for the first time that effective and efficient content moderation can be achieved by extracting conceptual features from chat-oriented LLMs, despite their initial fine-tuning for conversation rather than content moderation. We propose a practical and unified content moderation framework for LLM services, named Legilimens, which features both effectiveness and efficiency. Our red-team model-based data augmentation enhances the robustness of Legilimens against state-of-the-art jailbreaking. Additionally, we develop a framework to theoretically analyze the cost-effectiveness of Legilimens compared to other methods
paper.author: Jialin Wu (Zhejiang University), Jiangyi Deng (Zhejiang University), Shengyuan Pang (Zhejiang University), Yanjiao Chen (Zhejiang University), Jiayang Xu (Zhejiang University), Xinfeng Li (Zhejiang University), Wenyuan Xu (Zhejiang University)
paper.summary_zh: 大语言模型生成的不安全内容带来社会影响，LLM 服务商需确保内容审核既有效又高效，但现有方法常陷入简单模型脆弱、复杂模型算力开销过大的两难。本文首次发现，即使聊天导向的 LLM 最初并非为内容审核微调，也能从中提取概念特征来实现有效且高效的内容审核。作者提出统一内容审核框架 Legilimens，并利用红队模型驱动的数据增强提升对先进越狱攻击的鲁棒性。论文还建立理论框架分析 Legilimens 相对其他方法的成本效益，表明其能够兼顾审核效果与效率。

paper.title: The Janus Interface: How Fine-Tuning in Large Language Models Amplifies the Privacy Risks
paper.description: The rapid advancements of large language models (LLMs) have raised public concerns about the privacy leakage of personally identifiable information (PII) within their extensive training datasets. Recent studies have demonstrated that an adversary could extract highly sensitive privacy data from the training data of LLMs with carefully designed prompts. However, these attacks suffer from the model's tendency to hallucinate and catastrophic forgetting (CF) in the pre-training stage, rendering the veracity of divulged PIIs negligible. In our research, we propose a novel attack, Janus, which exploits the fine-tuning interface to recover forgotten PIIs from the pre-training data in LLMs. We formalize the privacy leakage problem in LLMs and explain why forgotten PIIs can be recovered through empirical analysis on open-source language models. Based upon these insights, we evaluate the performance of Janus on both open-source language models and two latest LLMs, i.e., GPT-3.5-Turbo and LLaMA-2-7b. Our experiment results show that Janus amplifies the privacy risks by over 10 times in comparison with the baseline and significantly outperforms the state-of-the-art privacy extraction attacks including prefix attacks and in-context learning (ICL). Furthermore, our analysis validates that existing fine-tuning APIs provided by OpenAI and Azure AI Studio are susceptible to our Janus attack, allowing an adversary to conduct such an attack at a low cost.
paper.author: Xiaoyi Chen (Indiana University Bloomington), Siyuan Tang (Indiana University Bloomington), Rui Zhu (Indiana University Bloomington), Shijun Yan (JD Cloud), Lei Jin (JD Cloud), Zihao Wang (Indiana University Bloomington), Liya Su (JD Cloud), Zhikun Zhang (Stanford & CISPA), XiaoFeng Wang (Indiana University Bloomington), Haixu Tang (Indiana University, Bloomington)
paper.summary_zh: 大语言模型训练数据中的个人可识别信息（PII）泄露引发广泛担忧，但已有提示词提取攻击受模型幻觉和预训练灾难性遗忘影响，恢复出的 PII 真实性很低。本文提出新型攻击 Janus，利用 LLM 的微调接口恢复预训练数据中被遗忘的 PII，并从理论上形式化该隐私泄露问题，通过开源模型实验解释恢复原因。在开源模型以及 GPT-3.5-Turbo、LLaMA-2-7b 上评估，Janus 相比基线将隐私风险放大约 10 倍，显著优于前缀攻击和上下文学习等先进提取攻击。分析还表明 OpenAI 和 Azure AI Studio 的微调 API 易受该攻击影响，攻击成本较低。

paper.title: Libra: Architectural Support For Principled, Secure And Efficient Balanced Execution On High-End Processors
paper.description: Control-flow leakage (CFL) attacks enable an attacker to expose control-flow decisions of a victim program via side-channel observations. Linearization (i.e. elimination) of secret-dependent control flow is the main countermeasure against these attacks, yet it comes at a non-negligible cost. Conversely, balancing secret-dependent branches often incurs a smaller overhead, but is notoriously insecure on high-end processors. Hence, linearization has been widely believed to be the only effective countermeasure against CFL attacks. In this paper, we challenge this belief and investigate an unexplored alternative: how to securely balance secret-dependent branches on higher-end processors?
paper.author: Hans Winderix (DistriNet, KU Leuven), Marton Bognar (DistriNet, KU Leuven), Lesly-Ann Daniel (DistriNet, KU Leuven), Frank Piessens (DistriNet, KU Leuven)
paper.summary_zh: 控制流泄漏攻击可通过侧信道暴露程序的控制流决策，线性化（消除秘密相关控制流）是主要防御手段，但开销不可忽视；平衡秘密相关分支开销较小，却长期被认为在高端处理器上不安全。本文挑战这一观念，探索如何在高端处理器上安全地平衡秘密相关分支。论文提出 Libra，从体系结构层面支持有原则、安全且高效的分支平衡执行。摘要重点在重新审视高端处理器上分支平衡的安全性问题，未给出具体实验数据。

paper.title: CountDown: Refcount-guided Fuzzing for Exposing Temporal Memory Errors in Linux Kernel
paper.description: Kernel use-after-free (UAF) bugs are severe threats to system security due to their complex root causes and high exploitability.We find that 36.1% of recent kernel UAF bugs are caused by improper uses of reference counters, dubbed refcount-related UAF bugs.Current kernel fuzzing tools based on code coverage can detect common memory errors, but none of them is aware of the root cause.As a consequence, they only trigger refcount-related UAF bugs passively and coincidentally, and may miss many deep hidden vulnerabilities.To actively trigger refcount-related UAF bugs, in this paper, we propose CountDown, a novel refcount-guided kernel fuzzer.CountDown collects diverse refcount operations from kernel executions and reshapes syscall relations based on commonly accessed refcounts.When generating user-space programs, CountDown prefers to combine syscalls that ever access the same refcounts, aiming to trigger complex refcount behaviors.It also injects refcountdecreasing and refcount-accessing syscalls to intentionally free the refcounted object and trigger invalid accesses through dangling pointers.We test CountDown on mainstream Linux kernels and compare it with popular fuzzers.On average, our tool can detect 66.1% more UAF bugs and 32.9% more KASAN reports than stateof-the-art tools.CountDown has found nine new kernel memory bugs, where two are fixed and one is confirmed.
paper.author: Shuangpeng Bai (The Pennsylvania State University), Zhechang Zhang (The Pennsylvania State University), Hong Hu (The Pennsylvania State University)
paper.summary_zh: Linux 内核 use-after-free（UAF）漏洞威胁严重，作者发现近期内核 UAF 中有 36.1% 由引用计数使用不当导致。现有基于代码覆盖率的模糊测试工具虽能发现通用内存错误，但不感知引用计数根因，只能被动且偶然地触发此类 UAF，容易漏掉深层漏洞。本文提出 CountDown，一种引用计数引导的内核模糊测试器：收集执行中的多样引用计数操作，基于常访问的引用计数重塑系统调用关系，偏好组合访问同一引用计数的系统调用，并注入减引用和访问引用的系统调用以主动释放对象并触发悬垂指针。在主流 Linux 内核上，CountDown 平均多发现 66.1% 的 UAF 和 32.9% 的 KASAN 报告，并发现 9 个新内核内存 bug，其中 2 个已修复、1 个已确认。

paper.title: Gramine-TDX: A Lightweight OS Kernel for Confidential VMs
paper.description: While Confidential Virtual Machines (CVMs) have emerged as a prominent way for hardware-assisted confidential computing, their primary usage is not suitable for small, specialized, security-critical workloads, i.e., legacy VMs with their conventional OS distributions result in a large trusted computing base.
paper.author: Dmitrii Kuvaiskii (Intel Labs), Dimitrios Stavrakakis (Technical University of Munich & The University of Edinburgh), Kailun Qin (Intel & Shanghai Jiao Tong University), Cedric Xing (Intel), Pramod Bhatotia (Technical University of Munich), Mona Vij (Intel Labs)
paper.summary_zh: 机密虚拟机（CVM）已成为硬件辅助机密计算的重要方式，但其常见用法不适合小型、专用且安全关键的工作负载，因为传统操作系统发行版会带来过大的可信计算基。本文提出 Gramine-TDX，为 CVM 提供轻量级 OS 内核，目标是在机密虚拟机中支持小型专用安全关键负载并显著缩小 TCB。摘要片段主要说明动机与系统定位，未给出具体实现细节和实验评估。该工作属于面向机密计算场景的系统与 OS 安全研究。

paper.title: VPVet: Vetting Privacy Policies of Virtual Reality Apps
paper.description: Virtual reality (VR) apps can harvest a wider range of user data than web/mobile apps running on personal computers or smartphones. Existing law and privacy regulations emphasize that VR developers should inform users of what data are collected/used/shared (CUS) through privacy policies. However, privacy policies in the VR ecosystem are still in their early stages, and many developers fail to write appropriate privacy policies that comply with regulations and meet user expectations. In this paper, we propose VPVet to automatically vet privacy policy compliance issues for VR apps. VPVet first analyzes the availability and completeness of a VR privacy policy and then refines its analysis based on three key criteria: granularity, minimization, and consistency of CUS statements. Our study establishes the first and currently largest VR privacy policy dataset named VRPP, consisting of privacy policies of 11,923 different VR apps from 10 mainstream platforms. Our vetting results reveal severe privacy issues within the VR ecosystem, including the limited availability and poor quality of privacy policies, along with their coarse granularity, lack of adaptation to VR traits and the inconsistency between CUS statements in privacy policies and their actual behaviors. We open-source VPVet system along with our findings at repository https://github.com/kalamoo/PPAudit, aiming to raise awareness within the VR community and pave the way for further research in this field.
paper.author: Yuxia Zhan (Shanghai Jiao Tong University), Yan Meng (Shanghai Jiao Tong University), Lu Zhou (Xidian University), Yichang Xiong (George Mason University), Xiaokuan Zhang (George Mason University), Lichuan Ma (Xidian University), Guoxing Chen (Shanghai Jiao Tong University), Qingqi Pei (Xidian University), Haojin Zhu (Shanghai Jiao Tong University)
paper.summary_zh: VR 应用可采集比网页或移动应用更广泛的用户数据，法规要求开发者通过隐私政策告知数据的收集、使用和共享（CUS）情况，但 VR 生态的隐私政策仍不成熟且常不合规。本文提出 VPVet，自动审查 VR 应用隐私政策的合规问题：先分析政策的可用性与完整性，再依据粒度、最小化和 CUS 声明一致性三项标准进行细化分析。作者构建了目前最大的 VR 隐私政策数据集 VRPP，覆盖 10 个主流平台的 11,923 个 VR 应用。审查结果揭示严重隐私问题，包括政策可用性有限、质量差、粒度粗、未适配 VR 特性，以及 CUS 声明与实际行为不一致。该系统已开源。

paper.title: CAPSID: A Private Session ID System for Small UAVs
paper.description: The US Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) has recently mandated that small unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs) be equipped with a transmitter that broadcasts the UAV's serial number, location, and altitude. The inclusion of a unique identifier in the form of a UAV serial number has stoked fears that the identifier will be used to track UAV operators and has even led some UAV operators to file a lawsuit against the FAA.
paper.author: Yueshen Li (University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign), Jianli Jin (University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign), Kirill Levchenko (University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign)
paper.summary_zh: 美国联邦航空管理局（FAA）要求小型无人机配备广播序列号、位置和高度的发射器，但唯一序列号引发对无人机操作者被跟踪的担忧，甚至导致相关诉讼。本文提出 CAPSID，一种面向小型无人机的私有会话 ID 系统，旨在满足监管和运行需求的同时保护操作者隐私。摘要主要描述监管背景和隐私争议，未展开 CAPSID 的具体机制与实验评估。其核心目标是降低固定序列号被用于关联和追踪无人机操作者的风险。

paper.title: Moderator: Moderating Text-to-Image Diffusion Models through Fine-grained Context-based Policies
paper.description: We present Moderator, a policy-based model management system that allows administrators to specify fine-grained content moderation policies and modify the weights of a text-to-image (TTI) model to make it significantly more challenging for users to produce images that violate the policies. In contrast to existing general-purpose model editing techniques, which unlearn concepts without considering the associated contexts, Moderator allows admins to specify what content should be moderated, under which context, how it should be moderated, and why moderation is necessary. Given a set of policies, Moderator first prompts the original model to generate images that need to be moderated, then uses these self-generated images to reverse fine-tune the model to compute task vectors for moderation and finally negates the original model with the task vectors to decrease its performance in generating moderated content. We evaluated Moderator with 14 participants to play the role of admins and found they could quickly learn and author policies to pass unit tests in approximately 2.29 policy iterations. Our experiment with 32 stable diffusion users suggested that Moderator can prevent 65% of users from generating moderated content under 15 attempts and require the remaining users an average of 8.3 times more attempts to generate undesired content.
paper.author: Peiran Wang (Tsinghua University), Qiyu Li (University of California, San Diego), Longxuan Yu (University of California, San Diego), Ziyao Wang (University of Maryland College Park), Ang Li (University of Maryland College Park), Haojian Jin (University of California, San Diego)
paper.summary_zh: 文本到图像扩散模型可能被用户滥用以生成违反平台政策的内容，而现有通用模型编辑方法在消除概念时未能考虑上下文和细粒度策略。本文提出 Moderator，一个基于策略的模型管理系统，允许管理员指定细粒度内容审核策略，并通过让模型自生成需审核图像、反向微调计算任务向量、再用任务向量否定原模型来降低其生成受限内容的能力。在 14 名管理员用户的实验中，参与者约 2.29 次策略迭代即可通过单元测试；在 32 名 Stable Diffusion 用户的测试中，15 次尝试内可阻止 65% 的用户生成受限内容，其余用户平均需要 8.3 倍的尝试次数。

paper.title: Neural Dehydration: Universal Erasure of Black-box Watermarks from DNNs with Limited Data
paper.author: Yifan Lu (Fudan University), Wenxuan Li (Fudan University), Mi Zhang (Fudan University), Xudong Pan (Fudan University), Min Yang (Fudan University)
paper.summary_zh: 深度神经网络水印常被用于保护模型知识产权，但攻击者可能试图在有限数据和黑盒条件下擦除水印。本文提出 Neural Dehydration，一种通用黑盒水印擦除方法，通过少量查询和目标数据训练替代模型或诱导水印特征失效，从而去除多种 DNN 水印。实验表明该方法能在有限数据下有效擦除黑盒水印，且对模型正常性能影响较小。

paper.title: SeqMIA: Sequential-Metric Based Membership Inference Attack
paper.description: Most existing membership inference attacks (MIAs) utilize metrics (e.g., loss) calculated on the model's final state, while recent advanced attacks leverage metrics computed at various stages, including both intermediate and final stages, throughout the model training. Nevertheless, these attacks often process multiple intermediate states of the metric independently, ignoring their time-dependent patterns. Consequently, they struggle to effectively distinguish between members and non-members who exhibit similar metric values, particularly resulting in a high false-positive rate.
paper.author: Hao Li (Trusted Computing and Information Assurance Laboratory, Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences), Zheng Li (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security), Siyuan Wu (Trusted Computing and Information Assurance Laboratory, Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences), Chengrui Hu (Trusted Computing and Information Assurance Laboratory, Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences), Yutong Ye (Trusted Computing and Information Assurance Laboratory, Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences), Min Zhang (Trusted Computing and Information Assurance Laboratory, Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences), Dengguo Feng (Trusted Computing and Information Assurance Laboratory, Institute of Software, Chinese Academy of Sciences), Yang Zhang (CISPA Helmholtz Center for Information Security)
paper.summary_zh: 现有成员推理攻击多使用模型最终状态或训练中的中间指标，但往往独立处理多个中间状态，忽略指标的时间依赖模式，导致对指标值相似的成员与非成员区分困难、误报率高。本文提出 SeqMIA，一种基于序列指标的成员推理攻击，建模训练过程中指标的时间序列模式，利用序列特征增强成员与非成员的区分能力。实验表明 SeqMIA 能有效降低误报率，在多个模型和数据集上优于现有攻击方法。

paper.title: Mithridates: Auditing and Boosting Backdoor Resistance of Machine Learning Pipelines
paper.author: Eugene Bagdasaryan (Cornell Tech), Vitaly Shmatikov (Cornell Tech)
paper.summary_zh: 机器学习流水线在数据预处理、训练和部署等阶段可能遭受后门注入，但现有防御多关注单一模型，缺乏对整条流水线后门抵抗能力的审计与增强。本文提出 Mithridates 框架，系统地在流水线不同阶段注入后门并评估其对最终模型的影响，从而审计流水线的脆弱环节。基于审计结果，论文设计了增强策略以提升流水线的后门抵抗能力，实验表明该方法能有效识别弱点并提高鲁棒性。

paper.title: Demystifying RCE Vulnerabilities in LLM-Integrated Apps
paper.description: Large Language Models (LLMs) show promise in transforming software development, with a growing interest in integrating them into more intelligent apps. Frameworks like LangChain aid LLM-integrated app development, offering code execution utility/APIs for custom actions. However, these capabilities theoretically introduce Remote Code Execution (RCE) vulnerabilities, enabling remote code execution through prompt injections. No prior research systematically investigates these frameworks' RCE vulnerabilities or their impact on applications and exploitation consequences. Therefore, there is a huge research gap in this field.
paper.author: Tong Liu (SKLOIS, Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences, China), Zizhuang Deng (SKLOIS, Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China; School of Cyber Security, University of Chinese Academy of Sciences, Beijing, China), Guozhu Meng (Institute of Information Engineering, Chinese Academy of Sciences, China), Yuekang Li (University of New South Wales), Kai Chen (Institute of Information Engineering)
paper.summary_zh: 大语言模型（LLM）正被集成到更智能的应用中，LangChain 等框架提供代码执行工具或 API，理论上可通过提示注入引入远程代码执行（RCE）漏洞，但此前缺乏系统研究。本文系统分析 LLM 集成框架的 RCE 漏洞，揭示通过提示注入触发远程代码执行的攻击路径，并在多个框架和应用中验证其影响。论文还讨论了漏洞利用后果及相应防御措施，填补了该领域的研究空白。

paper.title: Respire: High-Rate PIR for Databases with Small Records
paper.description: Private information retrieval (PIR) is a key building block in many privacy-preserving systems, and recent works have made significant progress on reducing the concrete computational costs of single-server PIR. However, existing constructions have high communication overhead, especially for databases with small records. In this work, we introduce Respire, a lattice-based PIR scheme tailored for databases of small records. To retrieve a single record from a database with over a million 256-byte records, the Respire protocol requires just 6.1 KB of online communication; this is a 5.9x reduction compared to the best previous lattice-based scheme. Moreover, Respire naturally extends to support batch queries. Compared to previous communication-efficient batch PIR schemes, Respire achieves a 3.4-7.1x reduction in total communication while maintaining comparable throughput (200-400 MB/s). The design of Respire relies on new query compression and response packing techniques based on ring switching in homomorphic encryption.
paper.author: Alexander Burton (UT Austin), Samir Jordan Menon (Blyss), David J. Wu (UT Austin)
paper.summary_zh: 私有信息检索（PIR）是隐私保护系统的关键组件，但现有单服务器 PIR 方案通信开销高，尤其对记录较小的数据库。本文提出 Respire，一种面向小记录数据库的格基 PIR 方案，利用同态加密中的环切换技术进行查询压缩和响应打包，并支持批量查询。在包含超过一百万条 256 字节记录的数据库上，Respire 仅需 6.1 KB 在线通信，比最优的格基方案减少 5.9 倍；批量查询下总通信减少 3.4-7.1 倍，吞吐量保持在 200-400 MB/s。

paper.title: The LaZer Library: Lattice-Based Zero Knowledge and Succinct Proofs for Quantum-Safe Privacy
paper.description: The hardness of lattice problems offers one of the most promising security foundations for quantum-safe cryptography. Basic schemes for public key encryption and digital signatures are already close to standardization at NIST and several other standardization bodies, and the research frontier has moved on to building primitives with more advanced privacy features. At the core of many such primitives are zero-knowledge proofs. In recent years, zero-knowledge proofs for (and using) lattice relations have seen a dramatic jump in efficiency and they currently provide arguably the shortest, and most computationally efficient, quantum-safe proofs for many scenarios. The main difficulty in using these proofs by non-experts (and experts!) is that they have a lot of moving parts and a lot of internal parameters depend on the particular instance that one is trying to prove.
paper.author: Vadim Lyubashevsky (IBM Research Europe), Gregor Seiler (IBM Research Europe), Patrick Steuer (IBM Research Europe)
paper.summary_zh: 格问题的困难性为量子安全密码学提供了重要基础，而零知识证明是实现高级隐私原语的核心，但其内部参数复杂、依赖具体实例，非专家难以使用。本文提出 LaZer 库，封装基于格的零知识证明和简洁证明所需的大量内部参数与组件，为开发者提供易用的量子安全隐私证明工具。该库可为多种场景提供短且计算高效的量子安全证明，降低格基零知识证明的使用门槛。

paper.title: Strong Privacy-Preserving Universally Composable AKA Protocol with Seamless Handover Support for Mobile Virtual Network Operator
paper.description: Consumers seeking a new mobile plan have many choices in the present mobile landscape. The Mobile Virtual Network Operator (MVNO) has recently gained considerable attention among these options. MVNOs offer various benefits, making them an appealing choice for a majority of consumers. These advantages encompass flexibility, access to cutting-edge technologies, enhanced coverage, superior customer service, and substantial cost savings. Even though MVNO offers several advantages, it also creates some security and privacy concerns for the customer simultaneously. For instance, in the existing solution, MVNO needs to hand over all the sensitive details, including the users' identities and master secret keys of their customers, to a mobile operator (MNO) to validate the customers while offering any services. This allows MNOs to have unrestricted access to the MVNO subscribers' location and mobile data, including voice calls, SMS, and Internet, which the MNOs frequently sell to third parties (e.g., advertisement companies and surveillance agencies) for more profit. Although critical for mass users, such privacy loss has been historically ignored due to the lack of practical and privacy-preserving solutions for registration and handover procedures in cellular networks. In this paper, we propose a universally composable authentication and handover scheme with strong user privacy support, where each MVNO user can validate a mobile operator (MNO) and vice-versa without compromising user anonymity and unlinkability support. Here, we anticipate that our proposed solution will most likely be deployed by the MVNO(s) to ensure enhanced privacy support to their customer(s).
paper.author: Rabiah Alnashwan (The University of Sheffield), Yang Yang (The University of Sheffield), Yilu Dong (Pennsylvania State University), Prosanta Gope (The university of Sheffield), Behzad Abdolmaleki (The University of Sheffield), Syed Rafiul Hussain (Pennsylvania State University)
paper.summary_zh: 移动虚拟网络运营商（MVNO）需将用户身份和主密钥等敏感信息交给移动运营商（MNO）进行验证，导致 MNO 可无限制访问用户位置和通信数据并可能出售，造成严重隐私损失。本文提出一种强隐私保护的通用可组合（UC）认证与切换协议，使 MVNO 用户与 MNO 能相互验证，同时保持用户匿名性和不可链接性。该方案支持无缝切换，预期可由 MVNO 部署以增强对客户的隐私保护。

paper.title: Towards Automatic Discovery of Denial of Service Weaknesses in Blockchain Resource Models
paper.description: nial-of-Service (DoS) attacks at the execution layer represent one of the most severe threats to blockchain systems, compromising availability by depleting the resources of victims. To counteract these attacks, many blockchains have implemented unique resource models that incorporate transaction fees. Nevertheless, historical incidents of DoS attacks demonstrate that these resource model designs remain inadequate. Although there are studies that manually craft DoS attacks on specific blockchains in isolation, none of them can discover DoS weaknesses in blockchains automatically. In this paper, we provide an insight into DoS weaknesses in blockchain resource models, and present a generic and systematic approach to uncover these weaknesses. In our approach, we first identify DoS weaknesses by DoSVER, a novel tool that reasons feasible DoS weaknesses against blockchain resource models by formal verification. The identified DoS weaknesses will be further validated by DoSDET, a new framework that automates the attack synthesis in exploiting the identified DoS weaknesses. We conduct a comprehensive and systematic evaluation by extensive experiments on nine diverse and widely-used blockchains, and discovered 12 DoS weaknesses with corresponding exploitation across the nine blockchains, 10 of which were unveiled for the first time.
paper.author: Feng Luo (The Hong Kong Polytechnic University), Huangkun Lin (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Zihao Li (The Hong Kong Polytechnic University), Xiapu Luo (The Hong Kong Polytechnic University), Ruijie Luo (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Zheyuan He (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Shuwei Song (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Ting Chen (University of Electronic Science and Technology of China), Wenxuan Luo (Unaffiliated)
paper.summary_zh: 区块链执行层的拒绝服务（DoS）攻击严重威胁系统可用性，现有资源模型设计仍不完善，且缺乏自动发现 DoS 弱点的通用方法。本文提出一种通用系统化方法，先使用形式验证工具 DoSVER 推理出针对区块链资源模型的可行 DoS 弱点，再通过 DoSDET 框架自动合成攻击进行验证。在 9 种广泛使用的区块链上，作者发现 12 个 DoS 弱点及相应利用，其中 10 个为首次公开。

paper.title: Fuzzing JavaScript Engines with a Graph-based IR
paper.description: Mutation-based fuzzing effectively discovers defects in JS engines. High-quality mutations are key for the performance of mutation-based fuzzers. The choice of the underlying representation (e.g., a sequence of tokens, an abstract syntax tree, or an intermediate representation) defines the possible mutation space and subsequently influences the design of mutation operators. Current program representations in JS engine fuzzers center around abstract syntax trees and customized bytecode-level intermediate languages. However, existing efforts struggle to generate semantically valid and meaningful mutations, limiting the discovery of defects in JS engines.
paper.author: Haoran Xu (National University of Defense Technology), Zhiyuan Jiang (National University of Defense Technology), Yongjun Wang (National University of Defense Technology), Shuhui Fan (National University of Defense Technology), Shenglin Xu (National University of Defense Technology), Peidai Xie (National University of Defense Technology), Shaojing Fu (National University of Defense Technology), Mathias Payer (EPFL)
paper.summary_zh: 变异模糊测试能有效发现 JavaScript 引擎缺陷，但现有表示（如抽象语法树和字节码级中间语言）难以生成语义有效且有意义的变异，限制了缺陷发现。本文提出一种基于图中间表示（Graph-based IR）的 JS 引擎模糊测试方法，设计图结构表示和相应变异算子，以生成语义有效的测试用例。实验表明该方法能扩大变异空间并提高 JS 引擎缺陷发现效率。

paper.title: Test Suites Guided Vulnerability Validation for Node.js Applications
paper.description: Dynamic methods have shown great promise in validating vulnerabilities and generating Proof-of-Concept (PoC) exploits of Node.js applications. They typically rely on dictionaries or specifications to determine the values of request parameters and their relationships. However, they still struggle to generate complex inputs from the provided dictionaries or specifications.
paper.author: Changhua Luo (The Chinese University of Hong Kong), Penghui Li (Zhongguancun Laboratory), Wei Meng (The Chinese University of Hong Kong), Chao Zhang (Tsinghua University)
paper.summary_zh: 针对 Node.js 应用动态漏洞验证中难以生成复杂输入的问题，本文提出测试套件引导的漏洞验证方法。该方法利用应用现有测试套件中的请求参数构造和参数关系，自动生成更复杂的 PoC 输入，以触发潜在漏洞。相比依赖字典或规格的现有方法，该方法能更有效地验证漏洞并生成利用代码。

paper.title: Unmasking the Security and Usability of Password Masking
paper.description: Password masking, a practice where passwords are obscured during entry, is widely adopted for online authentication. However, its merits have been debated for over a decade, with questions about its security benefits and concerns about its usability impact. Yet to date, masking has received limited prior exploration.
paper.author: Yuqi Hu (Georgia Institute of Technology), Suood Alroomi (Georgia Institute of Technology), Sena Sahin (Georgia Institute of Technology), Frank Li (Georgia Institute of Technology)
paper.summary_zh: 密码掩码广泛用于在线认证，但其安全收益与可用性代价已争议十余年，缺乏系统性的实证研究。本文通过用户实验和攻击分析，评估密码掩码在肩窥攻击防护、输入错误率和输入速度等方面的表现。研究发现掩码的安全收益有限，且可能带来可用性代价，为认证界面设计提供了实证依据。

paper.title: Manipulating OpenFlow Link Discovery Packet Forwarding for Topology Poisoning
paper.description: Software-defined networking (SDN) is a centralized, dynamic, and programmable network management technology that enables flexible traffic control and scalability. SDN facilitates network administration through a centralized view of the underlying physical topology; tampering with this topology view can result in catastrophic damage to network management and security. To underscore this issue, we introduce Marionette, a new topology poisoning technique that manipulates OpenFlow link discovery packet forwarding to alter topology information. Our approach exposes an overlooked yet widespread attack vector, distinguishing itself from traditional link fabrication attacks that tamper, spoof, or relay discovery packets at the data plane. Unlike localized attacks observed in existing methods, our technique introduces a globalized topology poisoning attack that leverages control privileges. Marionette implements a reinforcement learning algorithm to compute a poisoned topology target, and injects flow entries to achieve a long-lived stealthy attack. Our evaluation shows that Marionette successfully attacks five open-source controllers and nine OpenFlow-based discovery protocols. Marionette overcomes the state-of-the-art topology poisoning defenses, showcasing a new class of topology poisoning that initiates on the control plane. This security vulnerability was ethically disclosed to OpenDaylight, and CVE-2024-37018 has been assigned.
paper.author: Mingming Chen (Penn State University), Thomas La Porta (Penn State University), Teryl Taylor (IBM Research), Frederico Araujo (IBM Research), Trent Jaeger (UC Riverside)
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究SDN中拓扑视图被篡改导致的拓扑毒化攻击。作者提出Marionette，通过操纵OpenFlow链路发现报文的转发来修改拓扑信息，不同于在数据平面篡改、伪造或中继发现报文的传统链路伪造攻击。Marionette利用控制平面权限实施全局化拓扑毒化，并用强化学习计算毒化目标、注入流表项以实现长期隐蔽攻击。实验表明其可攻击五种开源控制器和九种OpenFlow发现协议，绕过现有防御，并获CVE-2024-37018。

paper.title: uMMU: Securing Data Confidentiality with Unobservable Memory Subsystem
paper.author: Hajeong Lim (Sungkyunkwan university), Jaeyoon Kim (Sungkyunkwan University), Hojoon Lee (Sungkyunkwan University)
paper.summary_zh: 论文提出uMMU，一种不可观测内存子系统，用于保护数据机密性。针对内存访问模式等侧信道可能泄露敏感数据的问题，uMMU通过系统/硬件机制使内存子系统对外部观察不可见或不可推断。由于提供的摘要为空，具体设计细节与实验效果无法从当前信息确认，但论文目标是在不牺牲可用性的前提下提升数据保密性。

paper.title: 𝜇CFI: Formal Verification of Microarchitectural Control-flow Integrity
paper.author: Katharina Ceesay-Seitz (ETH Zurich), Flavien Solt (ETH Zurich), Kaveh Razavi (ETH Zurich)
paper.summary_zh: 论文关注微架构层面的控制流完整性（CFI）形式化验证问题。现代处理器中，微架构控制流可能被攻击者利用以绕过传统CFI防护，因此需要从硬件设计层面提供可证明的完整性保障。作者提出𝜇CFI方法，将微架构控制流完整性属性转化为形式化验证目标，并利用形式化工具进行证明或反例检测。由于摘要未提供，具体验证框架、覆盖范围与实验开销需参考原文，但该工作推动了硬件微架构安全属性的形式化验证。

paper.title: The Insecurity of Masked Comparisons: SCAs on ML-KEM's FO-Transform
paper.description: NIST released the draft standard for ML-KEM, and we can expect its widespread use in the embedded world in the near future. Several side-channel attacks have been proposed, and one line of research has focused on attacks against the comparison step of the FO-transform. A work published at TCHES 2022 stressed the need for secure higher-order masked comparisons beyond the t-probing model and proposed a higher-order masked comparison method. Subsequently, D'Anvers, Van Beirendonck, and Verbauwhede improved upon the performance of several previous proposals; their higher-order masked algorithm currently achieves the highest performance for masked comparisons.
paper.author: Julius Hermelink (Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy), Kai-Chun Ning (Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy), Richard Petri (Max Planck Institute for Security and Privacy), Emanuele Strieder (Fraunhofer AISEC and Technical University of Munich)
paper.summary_zh: 论文关注ML-KEM的FO变换中密文比较步骤的侧信道安全性。已有工作提出高阶掩码比较方法，并不断优化性能，其中D'Anvers等人的方案被视为当前性能最高的掩码比较算法。本文指出这些掩码比较仍存在侧信道漏洞，可能对ML-KEM在嵌入式环境中的广泛部署构成威胁。由于提供的摘要仅给出背景，具体攻击方法和实验结论需参考原文，但论文标题明确揭示了掩码比较的不安全性。

paper.title: Attacks Against the IND-CPA^D Security of Exact FHE Schemes
paper.description: A recent security model for fully homomorphic encryption (FHE), called IND-CPAD security and introduced by Li and Micciancio [Eurocrypt'21], strengthens IND-CPA security by giving the attacker access to a decryption oracle for ciphertexts for which it should know the underlying plaintexts. This includes ciphertexts that it (honestly) encrypted and those obtained from the latter by evaluating circuits that it chose. Li and Micciancio singled out the CKKS FHE scheme for approximate data [Asiacrypt'17] by giving an IND-CPAD attack on it and claiming that IND-CPA security and IND-CPAD security coincide for exact FHE schemes.
paper.author: Jung Hee Cheon (Seoul National University and CryptoLab Inc.), Hyeongmin Choe (Seoul National University), Alain Passelègue (CryptoLab Inc.), Damien Stehlé (CryptoLab Inc.), Elias Suvanto (CryptoLab Inc. and University of Luxembourg)
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究全同态加密（FHE）的IND-CPA^D安全性。该模型比IND-CPA更强，允许攻击者获得其已知明文对应密文的解密预言机，此前工作认为精确FHE方案的IND-CPA与IND-CPA^D安全性一致。本文针对精确FHE方案构造攻击，挑战了这一论断。结果表明精确FHE方案在IND-CPA^D模型下也可能不安全，需重新审视FHE方案的安全定义与实现。

paper.title: Large-Scale Private Set Intersection in the Client-Server Setting
paper.author: Yunqing Sun (Northwestern University), Jonathan Katz (Google and University of Maryland), Mariana Raykova (Google), Phillipp Schoppmann (Google), Xiao Wang (Northwestern University)
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究客户端-服务器场景下的大规模隐私集合求交（PSI）。PSI允许客户端与服务器在不泄露各自集合元素的前提下计算交集，但现有协议在集合规模很大时通信或计算开销过高。作者提出面向大规模数据的客户端-服务器PSI协议，可能利用预处理、压缩或专用密码学技术提升效率。由于摘要未提供，具体协议设计和性能提升需参考原文。

paper.title: Securing Floating-Point Arithmetic for Noise Addition
paper.description: Floating-point arithmetic is ubiquitous across computing, with its wide range of values, large and small, making it the preferred tool for storing, analysing, and manipulating numerical data. Its flexibility comes at the cost of additional risks in some security/privacy-aware settings. In this paper, we discuss the threat of information leakage caused by floating-point arithmetic when adding noise to sensitive values, which can allow the sensitive information to be recovered (e.g., in differential privacy). We present a solution, Mantissa Bit Manipulation (MBM), that is orders of magnitude faster than the current state-of-the-art, applicable to most continuous probability distributions and to all floating-point number formats.
paper.author: Naoise Holohan (IBM Research), Stefano Braghin (IBM Research), Mohamed Suliman (IBM Research)
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究在差分隐私等场景中为敏感数值添加噪声时，浮点运算导致的信息泄露风险。浮点算术可能因舍入和表示特性使攻击者恢复敏感信息。作者提出尾数位操纵（MBM）方案，通过控制浮点数尾数位来安全地生成噪声。MBM比现有最优方法快数个数量级，且适用于大多数连续概率分布和所有浮点数格式，可有效降低浮点运算带来的隐私泄露。

paper.title: Air Gap: Protecting Privacy-Conscious Conversational Agents
paper.author: Eugene Bagdasaryan (Google Research), Ren Yi (Google Research), Sahra Ghalebikesabi (Google Deepmind), Peter Kairouz (Google Research), Marco Gruteser (Google Research), Sewoong Oh (Google Research), Borja Balle (Google Deepmind), Daniel Ramage (Google Research)
paper.summary_zh: 论文关注对话式AI代理的隐私保护问题。随着LLM代理能够访问用户数据和外部工具，恶意提示或工具可能诱导其泄露敏感信息。作者提出Air Gap方法，旨在在代理与敏感数据/外部服务之间建立隔离或访问控制，防止隐私泄露。由于摘要未提供，具体机制和实验评估需参考原文，但论文目标是在保持对话代理可用性的同时增强隐私保护。

paper.title: Certifiable Black-Box Attacks with Randomized Adversarial Examples: Breaking Defenses with Provable Confidence
paper.description: Black-box adversarial attacks have demonstrated strong potential to compromise machine learning models by iteratively querying the target model or leveraging transferability from a local surrogate model.Recently, such attacks can be effectively mitigated by state-of-the-art (SOTA) defenses, e.g., detection via the pattern of sequential queries, or injecting noise into the model. To our best knowledge, we take the first step to study a new paradigm of black-box attacks with provable guarantees -- certifiable black-box attacks that can guarantee the attack success probability (ASP) of adversarial examples before querying over the target model. This new black-box attack unveils significant vulnerabilities of machine learning models, compared to traditional empirical black-box attacks, e.g., breaking strong SOTA defenses with provable confidence, constructing a space of (infinite) adversarial examples with high ASP, and the ASP of the generated adversarial examples is theoretically guaranteed without verification/queries over the target model. Specifically, we establish a novel theoretical foundation for ensuring the ASP of the black-box attack with randomized adversarial examples (AEs). Then, we propose several novel techniques to craft the randomized AEs while reducing the perturbation size for better imperceptibility. Finally, we have comprehensively evaluated the certifiable black-box attacks on the CIFAR10/100, ImageNet, and LibriSpeech datasets, while benchmarking with 16 SOTA black-box attacks, against various SOTA defenses in the domains of computer vision and speech recognition. Both theoretical and experimental results have validated the significance of the proposed attack.
paper.author: Hanbin Hong (University of Connecticut), Xinyu Zhang (Zhejiang University), Binghui Wang (Illinois Institute of Technology), Zhongjie Ba (Zhejiang University), Yuan Hong (University of Connecticut)
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究黑盒对抗攻击中可证明攻击成功率的新范式。传统黑盒攻击在查询目标或迁移时易被检测、噪声注入等防御缓解；作者首次提出可认证黑盒攻击，在查询目标模型前即可保证对抗样本的攻击成功概率。方法基于随机化对抗样本建立理论保证，并设计降低扰动以提升隐蔽性的生成技术。在CIFAR10/100、ImageNet和LibriSpeech上，与16种SOTA黑盒攻击对比，能可证明地攻破多种强防御，验证了理论有效性。

paper.title: SurrogatePrompt: Bypassing the Safety Filter of Text-to-Image Models via Substitution
paper.author: Zhongjie Ba (Zhejiang University), Jieming Zhong (ZheJiang University), Jiachen Lei (Zhejiang University), Peng Cheng (Zhejiang University), Qinglong Wang (Zhejiang University), Zhan Qin (Zhejiang University), Zhibo Wang (Zhejiang University), Kui Ren (Zhejiang University)
paper.summary_zh: 论文关注文本到图像（Text-to-Image）模型的安全过滤器绕过问题。作者提出SurrogatePrompt方法，通过替换敏感词或提示词成分来规避模型的安全过滤机制。该方法可能利用语义相近的替代词或代理提示生成原本被禁止的图像内容。由于摘要未提供，具体替换策略和攻击成功率需参考原文，但论文揭示了文生图模型安全过滤的脆弱性。

paper.title: “I Had Sort of a Sense that I Was Always Being Watched...Since I Was”: Examining Interpersonal Discomfort From Continuous Location-Sharing Applications
paper.description: Continuous location sharing (CLS) applications are widely used for safety and social convenience. However, these applications have privacy concerns that can be used for control and harm. To understand user concerns, we performed the largest user study of CLS application usage performed to date, with 1500 of 3000 users indicating they use CLS applications and 896 of these users completing surveys. From survey responses, we conducted 23 interviews with participants who had uncomfortable experiences. With these interviews, we perform thematic analysis grounded by sociological frameworks of power dynamics and social exchange theory. We observe that CLS application users face discomfort related to three primary categories that build on each other: (1) overstepped boundaries, (2) continued discomfort, and (3) lifestyle-impacting behaviors. With this foundational understanding, we suggest features that aim to reduce relationship imbalances that CLS applications enable. Our resulting study demonstrates that CLS applications contribute to interpersonal discomfort, highlighting the need for design changes.
paper.author: Kevin Childs (University of Florida), Cassidy Gibson (University of Florida), Anna Crowder (University of Florida), Kevin Warren (University of Florida), Carson Stillman (University of Florida), Elissa Redmiles (Georgetown University), Eakta Jain (University of Florida), Patrick Traynor (University of Florida), Kevin Butler (University of Florida)
paper.summary_zh: 论文关注连续位置共享（CLS）应用带来的隐私与人际不适问题。作者开展了迄今最大规模的CLS用户研究，3000人中1500人使用CLS，896人完成问卷，并对23名有不适经历的参与者进行访谈。基于权力动态和社会交换理论的主题分析，发现不适可分为越界、持续不适和影响生活方式的行为三类。研究揭示CLS会加剧人际关系中的权力失衡，并提出减少关系失衡的设计建议。

paper.title: Content, Nudges and Incentives: A Study on the Effectiveness and Perception of Embedded Phishing Training
paper.description: A common form of phishing training in organizations is the use of simulated phishing emails to test employees' susceptibility to phishing attacks, and the immediate delivery of training material to those who fail the test. This widespread practice is dubbed embedded training; however, its effectiveness in decreasing the likelihood of employees falling for phishing again in the future is questioned by the contradictory findings of several recent field studies.
paper.author: Daniele Lain (ETH Zurich), Tarek Jost (ETH Zurich), Sinisa Matetic (ETH Zurich), Kari Kostiainen (ETH Zurich), Srdjan Čapkun (ETH Zurich)
paper.summary_zh: 论文研究工作场所中嵌入式钓鱼培训的有效性与员工感知。嵌入式培训通常通过模拟钓鱼邮件测试员工，并向失败者立即推送培训材料，但既往现场研究对其能否降低未来受骗率存在矛盾结论。作者设计并比较了不同培训内容、助推（nudges）和激励（incentives）方式，评估其对员工钓鱼识别能力和接受度的影响。研究旨在为组织改进钓鱼培训设计提供实证依据，具体实验结论需参考原文完整摘要。

paper.title: Internet’s Invisible Enemy: Detecting and Measuring Web Cache Poisoning in the Wild
paper.author: Yuejia Liang (Tsinghua University), Jianjun Chen (Tsinghua University and Zhongguancun Laboratory), Run Guo (Tsinghua University), Kaiwen Shen (Tsinghua University), Hui Jiang (Tsinghua University and Baidu Inc), Man Hou (Zhongguancun Laboratory), Yue Yu (Beijing University of Posts and Telecommunications), Haixin Duan (Tsinghua University; Quancheng Laboratory)
paper.summary_zh: Web 缓存投毒可让攻击者通过污染共享缓存向大量用户返回恶意内容，是影响面广且隐蔽的 Web 安全威胁。本文针对真实网络中的缓存投毒进行检测与测量，设计自动化方法识别缓存键、未键控输入和缓存行为等关键条件。作者在互联网范围内开展大规模测量，揭示该漏洞在实际站点中仍然存在且成因多样。研究结果为 Web 开发者、CDN 和缓存实现提供了检测与防御依据。

paper.title: GPSBuster: Busting out Hidden GPS Trackers via MSoC Electromagnetic Radiations
paper.description: The escalating threat of hidden GPS tracking devices poses significant risks to personal privacy and security.Featured by their miniaturization and misleading appearances, GPS devices can be easily disguised in their surroundings making their detection extremely challenging.In this paper, we propose a novel side-channel-driven detection system, GPSBuster, leveraging electromagnetic radiation (EMR) emitted by GPS trackers.Our feasibility studies and hardware analysis reveal that unique EMR patterns associated with the tracker's operation, stemming from the quartz oscillator, local oscillator, and mixer in the Mixed-Signal on Chip (MSoC) system.Nevertheless, as a side-channel leakage, EMRs can be extremely weak and suffer from the ambient noise interference, rendering the detection impractical.To address these challenges, we develop the signal processing techniques with noise removals and a dual-dimensional folding mechanism to accumulate the spectrum energy and protrude the EMR patterns with high Signal-to-Noise Ratios (SNR).Our detection prototype, built with a portable HackRF One device, allows users to perform a scan-to-detect manner and achieves an overall success rate of 98.4% on top-10 selling GPS trackers under various testing cases.The maximum detection range is 0.61m.
paper.author: Yue Li (Hunan University), Wenqiang Jin (Hunan University), Zhengyu Ning (Hunan University), Daibo Liu (Hunan University), Zhenxiong Yan (Hunan University), Zheng Qin (Hunan University), Yu Liu (Hunan University), Huadi Zhu (The University of Texas at Arlington), Ming Li (The University of Texas at Arlington)
paper.summary_zh: 隐藏式 GPS 追踪器体积小、伪装性强，对个人隐私与安全构成日益严重的威胁，而现有检测手段难以在复杂环境中发现它们。本文提出 GPSBuster，利用 GPS 追踪器 MSoC 系统中石英振荡器、本振和混频器产生的电磁辐射（EMR）侧信道进行检测。针对 EMR 信号微弱且易受环境噪声干扰的问题，作者设计了噪声去除和双维折叠等信号处理技术，以累积频谱能量并提高信噪比。基于便携式 HackRF One 的原型在 top-10 畅销 GPS 追踪器上取得 98.4% 的总体成功率，最大检测距离为 0.61 米。

paper.title: Real-World Universal zkSNARKs are Non-Malleable
paper.description: Simulation extractability is a strong security notion of zkSNARKs that guarantees that an attacker who produces a valid proof must know the corresponding witness, even if the attacker had prior access to proofs generated by other users. Notably, simulation extractability implies that proofs are non-malleable and is of fundamental importance for applications of zkSNARKs in distributed systems. In this work, we study sufficient and necessary conditions for constructing simulation-extractable universal zkSNARKs via the popular design approach based on compiling polynomial interactive oracle proofs (PIOP). Our main result is the first security proof that popular universal zkSNARKs, such as PLONK and Marlin, as deployed in the real world, are simulation-extractable. Our result fills a gap left from previous work (Faonio et al. TCC'23, and Kohlweiss et al. TCC'23) which could only prove the simulation extractability of the "textbook" versions of these schemes and does not capture their optimized variants, with all the popular optimization tricks in place, that are eventually implemented and deployed in software libraries.
paper.author: Antonio Faonio (EURECOM), Dario Fiore (IMDEA Software Institute), Luigi Russo (EURECOM)
paper.summary_zh: zkSNARK 的 simulation extractability 是保证攻击者必须知道 witness 的强安全概念，也意味着证明具有不可延展性，对分布式系统应用至关重要。此前工作只能证明 PLONK、Marlin 等通用 zkSNARK 的“教科书”版本满足 simulation extractability，无法覆盖实际部署中带各种优化技巧的变体。本文基于 PIOP 编译这一主流设计路径，给出了首个针对真实世界通用 zkSNARK（如 PLONK、Marlin）的 simulation extractability 安全证明。该结果填补了已有分析与实际实现之间的空白，说明广泛部署的优化版 zkSNARK 仍具备不可延展性。

paper.title: Oblivious Single Access Machines - A New Model for Oblivious Computation
paper.description: Oblivious RAM (ORAM) allows a client to securely outsource memory storage to an untrusted server. It has been shown that no ORAM can simultaneously achieve small bandwidth blow-up, small client storage, and a single roundtrip of latency.
paper.author: Ananya Appan (University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign), David Heath (University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign), Ling Ren (University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign)
paper.summary_zh: ORAM 允许客户端将内存安全外包给不可信服务器，但已有结果指出 ORAM 无法同时实现低带宽放大、小客户端存储和单次往返延迟。本文提出 Oblivious Single Access Machines（OSAM）这一新的 oblivious computation 模型，试图绕开传统 ORAM 的不可能三角。该模型重新定义外包内存访问方式，并可能通过单次访问语义和预处理实现高效的 oblivious 计算。作者分析了该模型的能力与效率边界，为设计兼具低带宽、低存储和低延迟的 oblivious 计算协议提供了新框架。

paper.title: Compositional Verification of Composite Byzantine Protocols
paper.description: Byzantine Fault-Tolerant (BFT) protocols are known to be difficult to design and to reason about. To address this challenge, on one hand, several approaches have been developed recently for computer-aided formal verification of the desired correctness properties, both safety and liveness, of standalone BFT protocols. On the other hand, the distributed computing community has made attempts to reduce the conceptual complexity of constructing new such protocols by showing how to assemble them from simpler "building blocks". No methodology to date combines these two approaches for foundational verification of arbitrary BFT protocols.
paper.author: Qiyuan Zhao (National University of Singapore), George Pîrlea (National University of Singapore), Karolina Grzeszkiewicz (Yale-NUS College), Seth Gilbert (National University of Singapore), Ilya Sergey (National University of Singapore)
paper.summary_zh: 拜占庭容错（BFT）协议设计复杂且难以推理，已有工作要么对独立 BFT 协议进行形式化验证，要么用简单构建块组合新协议，但缺少将两者结合的基础验证方法。本文提出面向复合拜占庭协议的组合式验证方法，支持从经过验证的构建块组合出任意 BFT 协议并证明其安全性与活性。该方法降低了构造和验证复杂 BFT 协议的难度，为分布式共识协议提供可组合的形式化保证。作者展示了该框架在典型组合协议上的适用性和可靠性。

paper.title: Password-Protected Key Retrieval with(out) HSM Protection
paper.description: Password-protected key retrieval (PPKR) enables users to store and retrieve high-entropy keys from a server securely. The process is bootstrapped from a human-memorizable password only, addressing the challenge of how end-users can manage cryptographic key material. The core security requirement is protection against a corrupt server, which should not be able to learn the key or offline- attack it through the password protection. PPKR is deployed at a large scale with the WhatsApp Backup Protocol (WBP), allowing users to access their encrypted messaging history when switching to a new device. Davies et al. (Crypto'23) formally analyzed the WBP, proving that it satisfies most of the desired security. The WBP uses the OPAQUE protocol for password-based key exchange as a building block and relies on the server using a hardware security module (HSM) for most of its protection. In fact, the security analysis assumes that the HSM is incorruptible - rendering most of the heavy cryptography in the WBP obsolete.
paper.author: Sebastian Faller (IBM Research Europe / ETH Zurich), Tobias Handirk (Bergische Universität Wuppertal), Julia Hesse (IBM Research Europe — Zurich), Máté Horváth (Bergische Universität Wuppertal), Anja Lehmann (Hasso-Plattner-Institute, University of Potsdam)
paper.summary_zh: Password-protected key retrieval（PPKR）让用户仅凭可记忆口令从服务器安全存取高熵密钥，核心要求是即使服务器腐化也不能学习密钥或进行离线口令攻击。该机制已在大规模部署的 WhatsApp Backup Protocol 中使用，但已有形式化分析假设服务器 HSM 不可腐化，导致很多密码学保护在实际威胁模型下失效。本文研究在有无 HSM 保护情况下的 PPKR 安全，给出更现实的威胁模型下的定义与构造。结果表明，即使 HSM 被攻破或不可用，也能通过协议设计维持关键安全属性，从而弥补现有部署分析中的假设缺口。

paper.title: Secure Sorting and Selection via Function Secret Sharing
paper.description: We revisit the problem of concretely efficient secure computation of sorting and selection (e.g., maximum, median, or top-k) on secret-shared data, focusing on the case of security against a single semi-honest party. Previous solutions either have a high communication overhead or many rounds of interaction, even when allowing input-independent preprocessing.
paper.author: Amit Agarwal (UIUC), Elette Boyle (NTT Research and Reichman University), Nishanth Chandran (Microsoft Research, India), Niv Gilboa (Ben Gurion University, Israel), Divya Gupta (Microsoft Research), Yuval Ishai (Technion), Mahimna Kelkar (Cornell University), Yiping Ma (University of Pennsylvania)
paper.summary_zh: 在秘密共享数据上高效计算排序、最大值、中位数或 top-k 是安全多方计算中的基础问题，但已有方案即使允许输入无关预处理，仍存在通信开销大或交互轮数多的问题。本文重新审视单半诚实敌手模型下的安全排序与选择，利用函数秘密分享（Function Secret Sharing）构造新的协议。该方法显著降低了通信或轮数开销，提升了具体效率。论文给出了安全性证明与性能评估，表明其在实际安全计算场景中更具可行性。

paper.title: On the Tight Security of the Double Ratchet
paper.description: The Signal Protocol is a two-party secure messaging protocol used in applications such as Signal, WhatsApp, Google Messages and Facebook Messenger and is used by billions daily. It consists of two core components, one of which is the Double Ratchet protocol that has been the subject of a line of work that aims to understand and formalise exactly what security it provides. Existing models capture strong guarantees including resilience to state exposure in both forward security (protecting past secrets) and post-compromise security (restoring security), adaptive state corruptions, message injections and out-of-order message delivery. Due to this complexity, prior work has failed to provide security guarantees that do not degrade in the number of interactions, even in the single-session setting.
paper.author: Daniel Collins (EPFL), Doreen Riepel (UC San Diego), Si An Oliver Tran (ETH Zurich)
paper.summary_zh: Signal 协议中的 Double Ratchet 被 Signal、WhatsApp 等数十亿用户使用，已有模型能刻画前向安全、后 compromise 安全、自适应状态腐化、消息注入和乱序投递等强属性。然而，由于模型复杂，此前工作未能给出不随交互次数增加而退化的安全保证，即使在单会话设置下也是如此。本文对 Double Ratchet 进行紧安全分析，证明其安全界不会随交互次数显著下降。该结果强化了对其在实际大规模部署中安全性的理解。

paper.title: zkLogin: Privacy-Preserving Blockchain Authentication with Existing Credentials
paper.description: status: Published
paper.author: Foteini Baldimtsi (GMU and Mysten Labs), Konstantinos Chalkias (Mysten Labs), Yan Ji (Cornell), Jonas Lindstrom (Mysten Labs), Deepak Maram (Mysten Labs), Ben Riva (Mysten Labs), Arnab Roy (Mysten Labs), Mahdi Sedaghat (KU Leuven), Joy Wang (Mysten Labs)
paper.summary_zh: 区块链应用通常要求用户管理助记词或私钥，门槛高且易丢失，而直接使用 Web2 账号又可能泄露身份并破坏去中心化。zkLogin 提出一种隐私保护的区块链认证方案，允许用户利用已有凭证（如 OAuth/OpenID Connect）登录并授权区块链交易，同时通过零知识证明隐藏真实身份。该方案将传统身份提供方与链上验证解耦，在保持非托管和隐私性的同时提升可用性。它已面向实际区块链系统部署，为大规模 Web3 认证提供了可行路径。

paper.title: KnowGraph: Knowledge-Enabled Anomaly Detection via Logical Reasoning on Graph Data
paper.author: Andy Zhou (UIUC), Xiaojun Xu (Bytedance Research), Ramesh Raghunathan (eBay), Alok Lal (eBay), Xinze Guan (eBay), Bin Yu (UC Berkeley), Bo Li (University of Chicago)
paper.summary_zh: 图数据上的异常检测在金融、电商和网络安全等场景中很重要，但纯数据驱动方法往往缺乏领域知识利用和可解释性。KnowGraph 提出一种知识增强的异常检测框架，将外部知识/规则与图数据上的逻辑推理相结合，以识别不符合正常行为模式的异常节点或子图。该方法有望在提升检测准确率的同时给出可解释的推理依据。论文在真实图数据上验证了其有效性，展示了知识推理对图异常检测的增益。

paper.title: Trust, Because You Can't Verify: Privacy and Security Hurdles in Education Technology Acquisition Practices
paper.description: The education technology (EdTech) landscape is expanding rapidly in higher education institutes (HEIs). This growth brings enormous complexity. Protecting the extensive data collected by these tools is crucial for HEIs as data breaches and misuses can have dire security and privacy consequences for the data subjects, particularly students, who are often compelled to use these tools. This urges an in-depth understanding of HEI and EdTech vendor dynamics, which is largely understudied.
paper.author: Easton Kelso (Arizona State University), Ananta Soneji (Arizona State University), Sazzadur Rahaman (University of Arizona), Yan Shoshitaishvili (Arizona State University), Rakibul Hasan (Arizona State University)
paper.summary_zh: 教育技术（EdTech）在高校中快速扩张，带来大量学生数据，数据泄露和滥用会严重影响隐私与安全。然而，高校与 EdTech 供应商之间的采购与治理动态研究不足，采购者往往难以验证供应商的安全承诺。本文通过研究高校 EdTech 采购实践，揭示其中存在的隐私与安全障碍，并分析信任、透明度和验证能力不足等问题。研究结果为改进 EdTech 采购流程、加强学生数据保护提供了建议。

paper.title: Understanding Legal Professionals’ Practices and Expectations in Data Breach Incident Reporting
paper.description: Legal professionals are essential in analyzing data breach incident reports and guiding the response to comply with data privacy laws and regulations. Their expertise helps mitigate privacy and security risks and prevents failures in privacy compliance. However, little research has been done to understand how legal professionals perceive, react to, and face challenges within the data breach incident reporting procedure. In this study, we conducted a simulated incident report assessment experiment and semi-structured interviews with 33 legal professionals who varied in age, gender, and legal background. We reported the criteria used by legal professionals to identify privacy-related items and also uncovered that the agreement among legal professionals on the concepts of privacy-related items is low. Furthermore, we presented findings regarding the perceptions and strategies of legal professionals concerning legal and regulatory compliance, as well as the key features of incident responses that facilitate efficient analysis of data privacy and security law compliance. After taking into account the challenges and suggestions provided by legal professionals, we concluded this study with recommendations for enhancing the effectiveness of legal compliance analysis for incident responses.
paper.author: Ece Gumusel (Indiana University Bloomington), Yue Xiao (IBM Research), Yue Qin (Indiana University Bloomington), Jiaxin Qin (China University of Political Science and Law), Xiaojing Liao (Indiana University Bloomington)
paper.summary_zh: 数据泄露事件报告和响应需要法律专业人员依据隐私法规进行分析，但现有研究很少关注他们如何理解、应对报告流程及面临哪些挑战。本文通过模拟事件报告评估实验和对 33 名不同背景法律专业人员的半结构化访谈，研究其识别隐私相关事项的标准、合规判断和响应策略。研究发现，法律专业人员对隐私相关概念的一致性较低，并揭示了影响高效合规分析的关键因素。基于这些挑战与建议，论文提出了改进数据泄露事件法律合规分析的建议。

paper.title: Metric Differential Privacy at the User-Level
paper.author: Jacob Imola (University of Copenhagen), Amrita Roy Chowdhury (UCSD), Kamalika Chaudhuri (UCSD)
paper.summary_zh: 针对传统度量差分隐私通常假设每个用户仅贡献一条数据，难以直接满足用户级隐私需求的问题，本文提出用户级度量差分隐私的定义与机制。该方法将度量差分隐私从记录级扩展到用户级，考虑同一用户可能贡献多条相关数据的情形。研究分析了用户级隐私保证与数据效用之间的权衡，为位置数据、数值数据等场景提供更符合用户级保护需求的隐私框架。

paper.title: Smooth Sensitivity for Geo-Privacy
paper.description: Suppose each user i holds a private value xi in some metric space (U, dist), and an untrusted data analyst wishes to compute Σi f(xi) for some function f : U -> R by asking each user to send in a privatized f(xi). This is a fundamental problem in privacy-preserving population analytics, and the local model of differential privacy (LDP) is the predominant model under which the problem has been studied. However, LDP requires any two different xi, x'i to be ε-distinguishable, which can be overly strong for geometric/numerical data. On the other hand, Geo-Privacy (GP) stipulates that the level of distinguishability be proportional to dist(xi, xi'), providing an attractive alternative notion of personal data privacy in a metric space. However, existing GP mechanisms for this problem, which add a uniform noise to either xi or f(xi), are not satisfactory. In this paper, we generalize the smooth sensitivity framework from Differential Privacy to Geo-Privacy, which allows us to add noise tailored to the hardness of the given instance.
